The toy store of my childhood dreams is here, but someone left 20,000 toys scattered all over the floor. Together with your friends, you will transform a disorganized toy store into a perfectly organized world, finding a home for every doll, dinosaur, train and toy car. <For embedded content, please go to the core to view it> The game contains multiple levels, and you will gradually discover more than 400 toys with different shapes. Storage is not just about clearing away clutter, it is also a process of awakening. After completing the return of an exhibition area, the toy train will start, the doll house will be built, and the colorful three-dimensional models will be presented one by one. The entire toy store will slowly come to life in your hands. There is no time limit or pressure in the game. You can immerse yourself in the details at your own pace and watch the chaos unfold step by step.

en.summary: Developed and published by Serenity Forge (who has released "To the Moon", "Dokiki Literary Club Plus!", "Killing Princess", etc.) and co-published by Mecrew Games, the rhythm visual novel game "Rhythm Paw" is now available on Nintendo Switch, Xbox, Steam and Epic Games Store, and is priced at RMB 18 in Steam in China. <For embedded content, please go to the machine core to view> The protagonist of "Rhythm Paw" is Claire, a young witch. In order to find her missing dog, she entered the "dog underworld". At the beginning of the journey, the demon Lunn accompanied her and became her new friend. Along the way, they encounter many ghostly dogs, each with a unique story of friendship, love, and loss. Through these encounters, Claire establishes new bonds and steps closer to reuniting with her dog.

zh.title: 反过来，利用计算机大敌“热噪声”来实现省电的“热力学计算”又是什么？
zh.summary: 热量导致原子和电子不规则地运动，从而引起电路的电压和电流的微小波动。这些随机波动被称为“热噪声”，在普通计算机中会受到抑制，因为它们会对计算造成干扰，但“热力学计算”的研究正在取得进展，它使用这种热噪声进行计算。与传统计算机相比，人工智能和科学计算所需的处理可能可以用更少的功耗和产生的热量来执行，但在撰写本文时，正在使用小型原型机和模拟来验证其原理。阅读更多...

en.title: What is "thermodynamic computing" that aims to save power by using "thermal noise", which was the enemy of computers, in reverse?
en.summary: Heat causes atoms and electrons to move irregularly, causing small fluctuations in the voltage and current of the circuit. These random fluctuations are called ``thermal noise,'' and are suppressed in normal computers because they cause disturbances in calculations, but research is progressing on ``thermodynamic computing,'' which uses this thermal noise for calculations instead. It is possible that the processing necessary for AI and scientific calculations can be executed with less power consumption and heat generation than conventional computers, but at the time of writing the article, the principle is being verified using small-scale prototype machines and simulations. read more...

zh.title: 备受期待的美国高中开放世界游戏《Agefield High: Rock the School》开局并不顺利，负面评价如潮水般涌来。穿墙穿地的例子很多，和我梦想的青春有很大不同。
zh.summary: 本作因其以美国高中生活为背景的开放世界游戏的独特理念而备受关注，但截至发稿时，Steam 用户评价为“稍有差评”，面临严厉批评。

en.title: “Patlabor EZY” Chinese-style curry from “Shanghai Tei” is now available!? Collaboration with “Nagoya Fuji Soba” which is popular every year! Collaboration project started to commemorate the release of “File 2”
en.summary: The new animation in the Mobile Police Patlabor series, Mobile Police Patlabor EZY File 2, will be released in theaters on August 14, 2026. In conjunction with this, a ``Chinese-style curry'' that is a complete reproduction of the recipe from ``Shanghai Tei'' that also appears in the movie is now on sale. In addition, ``Nadai Fuji Soba,'' a stand-up soba chain, also holds popular collaboration projects every year.

zh.title: 身穿浴衣的“Chii Poke”千川人偶为夏天增色不少♪“阿波舞”中出现了展望台、新奇商品、限定商品【报道】
zh.summary: Chiikawa 的首个智能手机应用程序 Chiikawa Pocket 将于 2026 年 8 月 11 日至 15 日在德岛县德岛市举行的日本三大盂兰盆舞之一的阿波舞活动的同时，开放德岛市的象征眉山山顶的 Chiipoke 展望台。该活动是“Chiipoke Summer Festival 2026”的一部分， 8月12日，Amico大厦开始发放“Chiipoke夏日扇子”，现场挤满了前来参加祭典的人们。

en.title: "Chii Poke" Chikawa dolls in yukata color the summer ♪ Observation deck, novelty items, and limited goods appear at "Awa Odori" [Report]
en.summary: Chiikawa's first smartphone app, Chiikawa Pocket, is opening the Chiipoke Observation Deck on the summit of Mt. Bizan, the symbol of Tokushima City, in conjunction with Awa Odori, one of Japan's three major Bon dances, which is being held in Tokushima City, Tokushima Prefecture from August 11th to 15th, 2026. This event is being held as part of the "Chiipoke Summer Festival 2026," and on August 12th, the Amico Building began distributing "Chiipoke Summer Fans," which were crowded with many people who came to the festival.

en.title: A typical ``AI-like beautiful face'' with bilateral symmetry may alienate shoppers
en.summary: In China, the live commerce market that sells products through live streaming on the Internet has matured, and there is also live commerce by "AI streamers (AI moderators)" generated by AI. A Chinese research team has announced the results of a study that investigated the influence of the ``facial attractiveness'' of such AI moderators on users who watch the broadcast. read more...

zh.title: 典型的左右对称的“AI般的美脸”可能会疏远购物者
zh.summary: 在中国，通过网络直播销售产品的直播电商市场已经成熟，也有人工智能产生的“AI主播（AI主播）”的直播电商。中国的一个研究小组公布了一项研究结果，该研究调查了此类人工智能主持人的“面部吸引力”对观看广播的用户的影响。阅读更多...

en.title: Warner Bros. mentions sequel to 'Hogwarts Legacy' in letter to shareholders
en.summary: It has been revealed that the producer Warner Bros. has mentioned in a letter to shareholders dated August 6, 2026, a sequel to the open world action RPG ``Hogwarts Legacy'' set in the world of Harry Potter, which was released in 2023 and became a huge hit. The letter calls for "expanding the pipeline of game titles" and states that "a second installment of Hogwarts Legacy" is in the works. read more...

zh.title: 华纳兄弟在致股东的信中提到了《霍格沃茨遗产》的续集
zh.summary: 据透露，制作人华纳兄弟在2026年8月6日致股东的信中提到，以哈利波特世界为背景的开放世界动作角色扮演游戏《霍格沃茨遗产》的续集，该游戏于2023年推出并大受欢迎。这封信呼吁“扩大游戏系列”，并指出“《霍格沃茨遗产》的第二部分”正在开发中。阅读更多...

en.title: Drought caused by climate change may have an adverse effect on red wine grapes, leading to a decline in quality
en.summary: Rising temperatures and frequent abnormal weather events due to climate change are having various effects on the yield and quality of agricultural crops. A study of wine grapes grown in major wine regions showed that drought can negatively impact grapes grown for red wine. read more...

zh.title: 气候变化引起的干旱可能对酿酒葡萄产生不利影响，导致品质下降
zh.summary: 气候变化导致的气温上升和异常天气事件频繁发生，对农作物的产量和品质产生了不同程度的影响。对主要葡萄酒产区种植的酿酒葡萄的一项研究表明，干旱会对种植红酒的葡萄产生负面影响。阅读更多...

en.title: X open-sources timeline display algorithm & begins trial provision of tools that allow you to visualize the handling of your own account
en.summary: We have open sourced the algorithm that X uses to determine what is displayed on the timeline. At the same time, we have started offering a test feature called ``Under the hood'' that allows you to check how your posts are handled on the X system. read more...

zh.title: X 开源时间线显示算法并开始试用提供工具，让您可视化自己帐户的处理情况
zh.summary: 我们已经开源了 X 用于确定时间轴上显示内容的算法。同时，我们已经开始提供名为“Under the hood”的测试功能，允许您检查 X 系统上如何处理您的帖子。阅读更多...

en.title: Surveillance camera maker Flock announces measures to prevent unauthorized use, shortens data storage period from 30 days to 7 days and adds purpose-based filtering function
en.summary: Flock Safety (Flock), which is building a surveillance camera network for license plate tracking across the United States, has announced measures to prevent unauthorized use in response to scandals such as ``surveillance camera footage was being misused for stalking by police officers.'' read more...

zh.title: 监控摄像头制造商 Flock 宣布采取措施防止未经授权的使用，将数据存储期限从 30 天缩短至 7 天，并添加基于用途的过滤功能
zh.summary: Flock Safety (Flock) 正在全美范围内建立一个用于追踪车牌的监控摄像头网络，该公司已宣布采取措施，以防止未经授权的使用，以应对“监控摄像头镜头被警察滥用来跟踪”等丑闻。 阅读更多...

en.title: Push notifications warning of spyware attacks from Apple need to be taken seriously
en.summary: Apple regularly sends push notifications called ``Threat Notifications'' to users who are suspected of being targeted by spyware that can hack into their devices. read more...

zh.title: 通过服用“含有粪便中微生物的胶囊”来减少食物过敏的可能性
zh.summary: 食物过敏可能会危及生命，并且会引起食物过敏患者及其父母的极大焦虑。医学杂志《科学转化医学》报道了一项利用“粪便中含有微生物的胶囊”改善此类食物过敏的临床试验结果。阅读更多...

en.title: Possibility of reducing food allergies by taking ``capsules containing microorganisms contained in poop''
en.summary: Food allergies can be life-threatening and are a cause of great anxiety for people with food allergies and their parents. The results of a clinical trial to improve such food allergies with ``capsules containing microorganisms contained in feces'' were reported in the medical journal Science Translational Medicine. read more...

en.title: Supermassive announces new round of layoffs, affecting 75 employees
en.summary: Supermassive Games announced today the launch of the latest round of layoffs. The company stated that up to 75 employees will resign this time, which is also a difficult decision that has to be made. It is reported that the reason for the layoffs is attributed to the mixed reviews of the new game "Command 8020" and the sales performance that did not meet expectations. It should be noted that this is Supermassive’s third layoff in less than three years. The reason for the first two layoffs was also that the gaming industry was facing turmoil and the company needed to take urgent measures to deal with it. Industry insiders say that the gaming industry is currently undergoing tremendous changes, with thousands of developers being laid off every year. Senior developer Brenda Romero said earlier this year that this time will undoubtedly be worse than the industry crash of the 1980s. Although the gaming industry can still generate significant revenue, investors are clearly less patient in the current environment.

ja.title: スーパーマスシブが新たな一時解雇を発表、従業員75人に影響
ja.summary: Supermassive Games は本日、最新の人員削減の開始を発表しました。同社は今回、最大75人の従業員が退職すると発表したが、これも難しい決断を迫られる。解雇の理由は、新作ゲーム「Command 8020」に対する賛否両論の評価と、期待に届かなかった販売実績にあると報じられている。 Supermassiveにとって、これは3年以内で3度目の人員削減となることに留意すべきである。最初の 2 件の人員削減の理由は、ゲーム業界が混乱に直面しており、それに対処するために緊急の措置を講じる必要があったためでもありました。業界関係者によると、ゲーム業界は現在、大きな変化を迎えており、毎年数千人の開発者が解雇されているという。上級開発者のブレンダ・ロメロ氏は今年初め、今回は間違いなく1980年代の業界崩壊よりもひどいものになるだろうと語った。ゲーム業界は依然として多額の収益を生み出す可能性がありますが、現在の環境では投資家が明らかに忍耐力を失っています。

As the "Oscars of the gaming industry", the annual TGA Game of the Year Awards is regarded as one of the most important honors in the gaming industry. Just like the gaming industry, TGA is gradually crossing the boundaries of traditional media. As game IPs are frequently adapted into film and television works, award ceremonies are no longer just a mere recognition event, but have gradually evolved into a large-scale comprehensive entertainment event. en.title: Square Enix HD's consolidated financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027 show significant increases in sales and profits. New releases and catalog titles such as “FFVII Reverse” are performing well
en.summary: Square Enix Holdings today announced its consolidated financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. During the fiscal year under review, the digital entertainment business, especially HD games, recorded significant increases in sales and profits. The company explained that in addition to strong sales of new releases such as ``FFVII Rebirth'' and ``The Thousand-Year Tale of Elliot the Adventurer,'' sales of catalog titles also increased.

zh.title: Square Enix HD 截至 2027 年 3 月的财年第一季度的综合财务业绩显示，销售额和利润显着增长。新版本和目录标题（例如“FFVII Reverse”）表现良好
zh.summary: Square Enix Holdings 今天公布了截至 2027 年 3 月的财年第一季度的综合财务业绩。在本财年中，数字娱乐业务，尤其是高清游戏，销售额和利润均录得大幅增长。该公司解释说，除了《FFVII重生》和《冒险家埃利奥特的千年故事》等新作销量强劲外，目录作品的销量也有所增长。

en.title: Following Chrome, Edge has also started gradually disabling the Manifest V2 extension, which also affects traditional ad blockers such as uBlock Origin.
en.summary: Microsoft has announced that it will gradually disable extensions that use ``Manifest V2 (MV2)'' in Microsoft Edge from August 2026, and will proceed with the transition to ``Manifest V3 (MV3).'' For general users, the transition is scheduled to be completed by the end of 2026, and some ad blockers, such as the MV2 version of uBlock Origin, will no longer be available. read more...

zh.title: 继 Chrome 之后，Edge 也开始逐步禁用 Manifest V2 扩展，这也影响了 uBlock Origin 等传统广告拦截器。
zh.summary: 微软宣布，将从 2026 年 8 月起在 Microsoft Edge 中逐步禁用使用“Manifest V2 (MV2)”的扩展，并将继续过渡到“Manifest V3 (MV3)”。对于普通用户，过渡计划于 2026 年底完成，一些广告拦截器，例如 uBlock Origin 的 MV2 版本将不再可用。阅读更多...

On the other hand, some are concerned that the Cybersecurity Directorate under the president's control is now able to remove content after the fact, which previously required a court order. read more...

zh.summary: 美国国防部已将包括中国科技公司在内的300多家公司列入“支持解放军的公司名单”，并禁止未经政府批准的产品和软件进出口。据报道，为了缓解全球内存短缺问题，苹果正在测​​试长鑫存储技术公司（CXMT）的存储芯片。长鑫存储是一家中国半导体制造商，已成长为全球第四大 DRAM 制造商，但有消息指出，由于国防部规定，可能无法向苹果下订单生产定制芯片。阅读更多...

en.title: PC manufacturers start using memory from China's growing memory manufacturer CXMT, Apple also tests it, but is in a pinch as it cannot manufacture custom chips for Apple due to American regulations.
en.summary: The US Department of Defense has added more than 300 companies, including Chinese technology companies, to the ``List of Companies Supporting the People's Liberation Army'' and prohibits the import and export of products and software without government approval. In order to alleviate the global memory shortage, Apple is reportedly testing memory chips from ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT), a Chinese semiconductor manufacturer that has grown to become the world's fourth largest manufacturer of DRAM, but it has been pointed out that due to Department of Defense regulations, orders may not be placed to manufacture custom chips for Apple. read more...

en.title: I tried using "ScanWatch Vitals", an analog clock-like smart watch that measures sleep time and blood oxygen concentration for up to 35 days.
en.summary: Withings, a smart device manufacturer based in France, develops a variety of devices such as scales and smart watches. One of these is the ``ScanWatch Vitals,'' a smart watch that has a simple analog watch-like design and a built-in display that can display necessary information, and can also be used as a healthcare tracker. read more...

zh.title: 我尝试使用“ScanWatch Vitals”，这是一款类似模拟时钟的智能手表，可以测量长达 35 天的睡眠时间和血氧浓度。
zh.summary: Withings 是一家总部位于法国的智能设备制造商，开发体重秤和智能手表等多种设备。其中之一是“ScanWatch Vitals”，这是一款智能手表，具有简单的模拟手表式设计和内置显示屏，可以显示必要的信息，也可以用作医疗追踪器。阅读更多...

en.title: What changes occurred in an experiment in which low-income artists unconditionally receive ``basic income of approximately 160,000 yen per month''?
en.summary: Many artists, such as musicians, novelists, and illustrators, are struggling to make ends meet, and in many cases they are juggling full-time jobs or part-time jobs. Researchers at Indiana University in the United States reported on what changes occurred when such low-income artists received a basic income of $ 1,000 (about 160,000 yen) every month. read more...

zh.title: 低收入艺术家无条件获得“每月约16万日元的基本收入”的实验发生了什么变化？
zh.summary: 许多艺术家，如音乐家、小说家和插画家，都在努力维持生计，在许多情况下，他们要兼顾全职工作或兼职工作。美国印第安纳大学的研究人员报告了当此类低收入艺术家每月获得1000美元（约16万日元）的基本收入时会发生什么变化。阅读更多...

en.title: Is there a scientific basis for the goal of ``10,000 steps a day'' born from Japan's pedometer?
en.summary: Smart watches and health management apps sometimes show ``10,000 steps a day'' as a daily goal, and research has shown that ``people who walk more every day have a lower risk of death.'' Hunter Bennett, an exercise science researcher at the University of Adelaide in Australia, explains the origin of the number 10,000 steps, which has become a medical standard, and how to think about the number of steps and walking speed for health. read more...

zh.title: 日本计步器诞生的“每天一万步”目标有科学依据吗？
zh.summary: 智能手表和健康管理应用程序有时会显示“每天 10,000 步”作为每日目标，研究表明“每天步行较多的人死亡风险较低。”澳大利亚阿德莱德大学运动科学研究人员 Hunter Bennett 解释了已成为医学标准的 10,000 步数字的由来，以及如何考虑步数和步行速度对健康的影响。阅读更多...

en.title: EA plans to cut costs by $700 million per year and layoffs
en.summary: As investors such as the Saudi Public Investment Fund, private equity fund Silver Lake Capital and Affinity Partners complete the leveraged buyout of EA, the company will usher in a comprehensive "cost reduction and efficiency increase." It is reported that as EA has now completed its privatization, the company also needs to bear US$18 billion in debt. In order to repay approximately $1.8 billion in interest per year and ensure profits, EA will face significant cost reductions. According to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, cost cutting is EA's core task after completing the acquisition. EA has told bond investors that it plans to cut costs by $700 million annually, of which $170 million is "organizational efficiency optimization." In other words, mass layoffs are inevitable. It is worth mentioning that EA has been promoting employees to use artificial intelligence technology to improve productivity. EA told investors in 2025 that it hopes to use AI to assist in writing game codes and reduce operating costs.

ja.title: EAは年間7億ドルのコスト削減と人員削減を計画
ja.summary: サウジ公共投資基金、プライベート・エクイティ・ファンドのシルバー・レイク・キャピタル、アフィニティ・パートナーズなどの投資家がEAのレバレッジド・バイアウトを完了する中、同社は包括的な「コスト削減と効率の向上」を開始することになる。 EAは民営化を完了したため、180億ドルの負債も負担する必要があると報じられている。年間約 18 億ドルの利息を返済し、利益を確保するために、EA は大幅なコスト削減に直面することになります。ブルームバーグが関係者の話として伝えたところによると、コスト削減は買収完了後のEAの中核課題だという。 EAは債券投資家に対し、年間7億ドルのコスト削減を計画しており、そのうち1億7000万ドルは「組織効率の最適化」に充てると伝えている。言い換えれば、大量解雇は避けられないということだ。 EA が従業員に人工知能テクノロジーを使用して生産性を向上させるよう奨励していることは注目に値します。 EAは2025年に投資家に対し、AIを活用してゲームコードの作成を支援し、運営コストを削減したいと語った。

en.title: Chinese games are heading towards the global “player empire”
en.summary: Author: Bai Yazhou It is now 2026. When we talk about "Chinese games going overseas", what are we talking about? When it comes to categories, many people may still be stuck on the mobile side; when it comes to methods, many people may also mistakenly believe that it is still the "buying era" that relies on simple and crude traffic. All in all, this proposition itself has a certain passive meaning - after all, in many people's minds, going overseas is a new growth point, and it is also a means to avoid traffic difficulties. This statement is certainly true, but what cannot be ignored is the change in the entire cake: whether it is category or method, mobile terminals and purchase volume are already a thing of the past. More importantly, Chinese games themselves are also tearing off the labels of "volume purchasers" and "marginal participants", and are moving from simple "product output" to in-depth "ecological output", trying to deeply participate in the core chain of the global game industry. Data doesn't lie. In 2025, China will independently develop

en.title: Nintendo announces financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. Although sales and Switch 2 unit sales were lower than the same period last year, operating income increased by 150.5% due to tax refunds, etc.
en.summary: Nintendo today announced its financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. Although sales decreased 9.5% year-on-year to 517.8 billion yen, operating income increased 150.5% year-on-year to 142.5 billion yen due to factors such as tax refunds based on the US IEEPA. Nintendo Switch 2 hardware sales were 3.82 million units, a 34.4% decrease from the previous year.

zh.title: 任天堂公布截至 2027 年 3 月的财年第一季度财务业绩。尽管销量和 Switch 2 销量低于去年同期，但由于退税等原因，营业收入增长了 150.5%。
zh.summary: 任天堂今日公布了截至 2027 年 3 月的财年第一季度财务业绩。尽管销售额同比下降 9.5% 至 5178 亿日元，但由于基于美国 IEEPA 的退税等因素，营业收入同比增长 150.5% 至 1425 亿日元。 Nintendo Switch 2硬件销量为382万台，比上年下降34.4%。

Chinese games are heading towards a “player empire”
en.summary: Author: Bai Yazhou It is now 2026. When we talk about "Chinese games going overseas", what are we talking about? When it comes to categories, many people may still be stuck on the mobile side; when it comes to methods, many people may also mistakenly believe that it is still the "buying era" that relies on simple and crude traffic. All in all, this proposition itself has a certain passive meaning - after all, in many people's minds, going overseas is a new growth point, and it is also a means to avoid traffic difficulties. This statement is certainly true, but what cannot be ignored is the change in the entire cake: whether it is category or method, mobile terminals and purchase volume are already a thing of the past. More importantly, Chinese games themselves are also tearing off the labels of "volume purchasers" and "marginal participants", and are moving from simple "product output" to in-depth "ecological output", trying to deeply participate in the core chain of the global game industry. en.title: The chivalrous heart is not cold yet: Essays from TapTap's "Chivalrous Heart Discussing Tao" martial arts roundtable event
en.summary: A while ago, Lao Bai, Jerry and Engine and I recorded a radio broadcast about "Martial Arts". Everyone talked about their complicated feelings about this subject. Not long after the recording, TapTap contacted me and said that they would hold a martial arts game roundtable called "Xia Xin Lun Dao" during China Joy and asked me if I wanted to go. I said yes with little hesitation. As a person born in the 1980s who got into martial arts games from "Jin Yong's Legend of Heroes", this theme occupies a too important place in my game memory. Watching its ups and downs over the years, sometimes I feel that "martial arts is dead", and sometimes I can see several works that rekindle expectations. As for this round table, the four producers, Wu Di from "The Legend of the Sword", San Huang from "The Hidden Man", the Messenger from "Spiritual Beasts" and Hula from "The Unknown" - sat down and chatted for two hours. This is indeed a very rare opportunity. On the way to Shanghai by high-speed train, I was thinking, if there were 20 years ago

ja.title: 任侠の心はまだ冷めていない ～TapTap武道座談会イベント「任侠心道を語る～」エッセイ
ja.summary: 少し前に、ラオ・バイ、ジェリー、エンジンと私は「武道」に関するラジオ放送を録音しました。このテーマについて、誰もが複雑な思いを語った。レコーディングから間もなく、TapTap から連絡があり、チャイナジョイ期間中に「Xia Xin Lun Dao」という武術ゲームラウンドテーブルを開催するので、参加しないかと誘われました。私は少しためらいながら「はい」と答えました。 『金庸英雄伝説』から武侠ゲームにハマった1980年代生まれの人間として、このテーマはゲームの記憶の中で重要すぎる位置を占めています。長年にわたるその栄枯盛衰を見ていると、時には「格闘技は終わった」と感じることもあれば、時には期待を再燃させる作品もいくつか見受けられます。このラウンドテーブルでは、「The Legend of the Sword」のウー・ディ、「The Hidden Man」のSan Huang、「Spiritual Beasts」のメッセンジャー、「The Unknown」のHulaの4人のプロデューサーが座り、2時間にわたって語り合いました。本当にこれは非常に稀な機会です。高速鉄道で上海に向かう途中、もし20年前だったらと考えた。

zh.title: 人的智力逐渐下降的“逆弗林效应”是什么？
zh.summary: 在20世纪，人们观察到智商测试的平均分随着一代人而增加的“弗林效应”，但近年来，一些国家报告了智商测试平均分下降的“逆弗林效应”。一项针对约 394,000 名美国成年人的研究也证实，从 2006 年到 2018 年，多项认知能力测试的分数有所下降。阅读更多...

en.title: What is the "reverse Flynn effect" where people's intelligence gradually declines?
en.summary: In the 20th century, the ``Flynn effect'' was observed, in which the average score on an IQ test increases with each generation, but in recent years, the ``reverse Flynn effect'', in which the score decreases, has been reported in some countries. A study of approximately 394,000 American adults also confirmed a decline in scores on multiple cognitive ability tests from 2006 to 2018. read more...

en.title: A vulnerability is discovered that allows internal data to be sent externally by simply having Atlassian's AI "Rovo" read a document
en.summary: A vulnerability has been discovered in Atlassian's AI service ``Atlassian Rovo'' that allows internal data from Jira or Confluence to be sent externally by simply loading a document with malicious instructions embedded. According to security firm PromptArmor, users do not need to approve the transmission, and even if an organization's administrator disables web search, it will not prevent the attack. read more...

en.title: From Nuwa to "Nezha": What kind of story is "Ancient God: Feng Lixi" telling?
en.summary: Author: Bai Guangda Introduction: Why does Epic call it "God of War" with the Chinese creation myth theme? Harbin native Liu Dachui started playing "Contra" at the age of three. Later, he played the "God of War" trilogy on his bed in the dormitory of Beijing Institute of Technology. Later, he got an MMORPG engine and started making games. Later, he and his classmates worked on the stage arrangement graphics engine for the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games. Now, he has made a game called "Old God: Feng Lixi" using the UE5 engine. As a "20-year veteran of the game industry, a programmer, a PhD in graphics who has been in prison, and a technology enthusiast", he has many different expectations for games. On January 30, 2026, the "Youxiankan" column of Station B released a 5-minute trailer, which exceeded 3 million views in a few days: At the beginning of the creation of the world, the earth was affected by

ja.title: 女媧から「哪吒」へ：「古神：馮麗西」はどんな物語を語るのか？
ja.summary: 著者: Bai Guangda はじめに: なぜエピックは中国の天地創造神話をテーマにした本作を「God of War」と呼ぶのでしょうか?ハルビン出身のLiu Dachuiさんは3歳から「魂斗羅」を弾き始めた。その後、北京工業大学の寮のベッドで「ゴッド・オブ・ウォー」三部作をプレイした。その後、MMORPG エンジンを入手し、ゲームを作り始めました。その後、彼とクラスメートは、2008 年北京オリンピックの開会式と閉会式の舞台配置グラフィック エンジンに取り組みました。現在、彼は UE5 エンジンを使用して「Old God: Feng Lixi」というゲームを作成しています。 「ゲーム業界で 20 年のベテラン、プログラマー、服役経験のあるグラフィックスの博士号、そしてテクノロジー愛好家」として、彼はゲームに対してさまざまな期待を持っています。 2026 年 1 月 30 日、Station B のコラム「Youxiankan」で 5 分間の予告編が公開され、数日で 300 万回の再生回数を超えました。世界の創造の初めに、地球は次のような影響を受けました。

From the colorful badlands of the west to the fertile plains of the east, the Northern Plains State is filled with scenic highways, industrious industry, and unique landmarks waiting to be discovered behind the wheel, developers say. Whether players are traveling between bustling cities or through charming rural communities, each journey brings an authentic feel of the peaceful Garden State. Deliver cargo to major cities like Fargo, Bismarck, Grand Forks, Minot, and Williston, and explore charming settlements like Medora, home to the spectacular Theodore Roosevelt National Park. en.title: The thriller mystery interactive game "Thriller Paradise: Hirata's World" is now available on the Steam store page
en.summary: Created by OntologyPlay, the thriller interactive game "Thriller Paradise: Hirata's World" adapted from the classic copy of the three-day and two-sleep novel "Thriller Paradise" "Hirata's World" has been officially announced and is now available on the Steam store page. In this game, players will step into a world of chaos, terror, and monsters, pursue an old case that has been "concluded for many years," and use mysterious "exorcism" to bring peace to those in pain. In terms of plot, in a seaside town destroyed by a typhoon, you wake up from the ruins, lose all your memory, and are almost attacked by monsters. From the mouth of a strange creature, you learn that this place is not reality. The "sinners" in a murder case turned into monsters and wandered around the world forever. And you, as an "exorcist", will use "exorcism" to bring them peace. The developer stated that this game will feature a complete suspenseful story with a high proportion of animated film performances.

Among them, young people aged 18-29 accounted for 65%, and visitors from other provinces accounted for 63%. This exhibition fully demonstrated its industrial advantages. The number of professional visitors reached a record high of 44,245, of which overseas professional visitors accounted for 21%. en.title: The sales of the new work "Quiet Pastoral" by the "Ye Yue" team in Japan exceeded 100,000 units
en.summary: On August 3, Nippon One announced on the official X account of "Quiet Pastoral" that the cumulative domestic sales of this game in Japan exceeded 100,000 units. This statistic includes the total number of physical boxed edition shipments and digital download edition sales in Japan. At the same time, in response to the shortage of goods in some offline stores, the official said: "We are deeply sorry for the inconvenience caused to you. We are stepping up preparations and striving to replenish the goods as soon as possible. Please wait for a while." "Quiet Pastoral" was released on July 30. This game is a rural life simulation game created by the "Yemei" development team. Players will incarnate as children who have settled in Hetsin Village (Hetsugu Village) and live freely in the village with a strange atmosphere everywhere: cultivating farmland, raising livestock, interacting with villagers, fishing and leisure. But there are many "rules" in the village, such as no going out after 23 o'clock, etc. During the game, players will also gradually explore the secrets that the villagers have been hiding.

ja.title: 「Ye Yue」チームの新作『静かな田園』の日本での販売本数が10万本を突破
ja.summary: ニッポンワンは8月3日、『静かなる田園』のX公式アカウントにて、本作の日本国内累計販売本数が10万本を突破したと発表した。この統計には、日本における物理的なパッケージ版の出荷数とデジタル ダウンロード版の販売数の合計が含まれています。一方、一部の実店舗で品薄状態が続いていることを受け、関係者は「ご迷惑をおかけして大変申し訳ございません。準備を強化し、できるだけ早く商品を補充できるよう努めておりますので、今しばらくお待ちください」としている。 「静かな田園」は7月30日にリリースされました。このゲームは、「イエメイ」開発チームが制作した田舎暮らしシミュレーションゲームです。プレイヤーはヘツィン村（ヘツグ村）に定住した子供たちに転生し、農地を耕したり、家畜を育てたり、村人たちと交流したり、釣りやレジャーなど、どこもかしこも不思議な雰囲気の村で自由に暮らします。しかし、村には23時以降の外出禁止など、さまざまな“掟”があり、プレイヤーはゲーム中、村人たちが隠してきた秘密を少しずつ探っていくことになる。

en.title: Cumulative number of visitors to Nintendo Museum exceeds 1 million
en.summary: The official social media account of the Nintendo Museum announced that the cumulative number of visitors has exceeded 1 million. An official statement stated: "As of the end of July 2020, the cumulative number of visitors to the Nintendo Museum has exceeded 1 million. Since its opening in October 2024, many guests have visited the museum. We sincerely express our gratitude. Please support the Nintendo Museum in the future." The Nintendo Museum is a Nintendo museum that will open on October 2, 2024. Here, people can learn about the history of toys and games released by Nintendo so far. They can also try unique games that can only be experienced here and are adapted from prototypes of many past products. In the fall of 2026, the museum will also open a new dining facility "SUPER FAMILY RESTAURANT". Currently, if you want to enter the museum, you still need to make an appointment and participate in a lottery.

en.title: Why can voice AI respond so quickly? OpenAI explains how “GPT-Live” works

It explains how a user and an AI can talk at the same time, a design that allows a user to continue a conversation while leaving complex processing to another AI, and a technology that shortens the waiting time before starting communication. read more...

zh.title: 为什么语音AI能反应这么快？ OpenAI 解释“GPT-Live”的工作原理

zh.title: 在美丽的宇宙中飞行并与巨龙较量。与运营经理一起体验全新MMORPG《新纪元：原子》[CJ2026]

zh.title: 《水族馆不跳舞～想死的偶像～》Steam商店页面公开。前作的前传，主角是一个不受欢迎的偶像。

en.title: "Weekly 4Gamer" looking back at 4Gamer's week, July 27th - August 2nd, 2026
en.summary: From July 27th to August 2nd, 2026, there were 315 articles published on 4Gamer. Here's a quick look back at 4Gamer's week in the global gaming industry, featuring a variety of articles that will be informative just by reading, such as the play report of "ChinaJoy2026" which started in Shanghai and the session report of "CEDEC2026".

zh.title: 《4Gamer 周刊》回顾 2026 年 7 月 27 日至 8 月 2 日 4Gamer 一周
zh.summary: 2026年7月27日至8月2日，4Gamer上发表了315篇文章。下面就让我们来回顾一下4Gamer一周在全球游戏行业的风采，其中包括在上海开幕的“ChinaJoy2026”的游玩报告、“CEDEC2026”的分会报告等各种读起来就长知识的文章。

en.title: The “final chapter” of “Heaven Burns Red” has begun. A new unit “19A Unit” appears in the game, and a campaign to commemorate the 4.5th anniversary has started.
en.summary: WFS today (August 2, 2026) launched the 4.5th anniversary campaign for the dramatic RPG "Heaven Burns Red." An update was implemented accordingly, and the "final chapter" of this work has begun. Information about the new unit ``19A Unit'' that will appear in the new story has been revealed, and a special short story depicting the situation of 19A Unit has been added.

zh.title: 《天烧红》的“终章”已经开始。游戏中出现了新单位“19A单位”，并开始了纪念4.5周年的活动。
zh.summary: WFS 今天（2026 年 8 月 2 日）推出了戏剧角色扮演游戏《天堂燃烧红色》的 4.5 周年纪念活动。相应地进行了更新，这项工作的“最终章”已经开始。新故事中出现的新单位“19A单位”的信息已公开，并追加了描述19A单位状况的特别短篇故事。

en.title: The second collaboration event of “Wilderness Action” x “Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba” starts today. A limited mode “Infinite Castle Battle” has been implemented in which you can control “breathing” and fight demons on a 3D map.
en.summary: NetEaseGames today (August 2, 2026) started the second collaboration event with the anime "Kimetsu no Yaiba" in the battle royale game "Wilderness Action". In this collaboration event, a limited mode called ``Infinite Castle Battle'' will be implemented, in which players fight demons by manipulating their breathing while exploring a 3D map that looks like an infinite castle.

zh.title: 《荒野行动》×《鬼灭之刃》的第二次合作活动今天开始。新增限定模式“无限城堡战”，可以控制“呼吸”，在3D地图上与恶魔战斗。
zh.summary: 网易游戏今日（2026年8月2日）在大逃杀游戏《荒野行动》中开启了与动漫《鬼灭之刃》的第二次合作活动。在本次合作活动中，将实施名为“无限城堡战斗”的限定模式，玩家在探索看似无限城堡的3D地图的同时，通过操纵呼吸与恶魔战斗。

en.title: ``Ryu to Mahjong'' is a roguelite that builds decks using mahjong tiles. You can play without any knowledge and learn how to play naturally [CJ2026]
en.summary: ``Ryu to Mahjong,'' which I tried out at ChinaJoy2026, is a deck-building roguelite that uses mahjong tiles as decks to form roles and fight against enemies. We will introduce the combat system using mahjong tiles, the stacking of roles, strengthening elements that change the tiles, the modern fantasy worldview, and the aims of the developer.

zh.title: 《Ryu to Mahjong》是一款使用麻将牌构建牌组的 Roguelite 游戏。无需任何知识即可玩，自然地学习如何玩[CJ2026]
zh.summary: 我在ChinaJoy2026上尝试过的《龙与麻将》是一款以麻将牌为牌组来组建角色并与敌人战斗的套牌Roguelite游戏。我们将介绍使用麻将牌的战斗系统、角色的堆叠、改变麻将牌的强化元素、现代奇幻世界观以及开发者的目标。

en.title: The production of "Second Super Robot Wars Z: Hakaikan Remastered" has been announced. The latest DLC for “Super Robot Wars Y” will be released on August 5th.
en.summary: Bandai Namco Entertainment held a live broadcast to commemorate the 35th anniversary of the ``Super Robot Wars'' series and announced the production of ``The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z Hakkaihen Remaster.'' Furthermore, the release date of the DLC ``Anniversary Expansion Pack'' for ``Super Robot Wars Y'' has also been revealed.

zh.title: 《第二次超级机器人大战Z：Hakaikan Remastered》的制作已经公布。 《超级机器人大战Y》最新DLC将于8月5日发售。
zh.summary: 万代南梦宫娱乐举办了纪念《超级机器人大战》系列35周年的直播，并宣布制作《第二代超级机器人大战Z八海变重制版》。此外，《超级机器人大战Y》的DLC《周年纪念扩展包》的发售日期也已公开。

en.title: Cloaked in the power of water, it runs freely on the ground and in the air. Clash with Jingtian in the trial play of "Ancient God: N'eru" [CJ2026]
en.summary: GenigodsLab is exhibiting a playable new action RPG, ``Ancient God: N'wu,'' which is based on the Chinese creation myth, at the large game event ``ChinaJoy2026.'' At the venue, we were able to experience an exhilarating action fight that makes full use of the power of water and sacred treasures, as well as a boss battle against the formidable enemy "The Arrogance of Keiten", so let's introduce the contents.

zh.title: 它披着水的力量，在地面和空中自由奔跑。 《古神：尼禄》试玩与景天的对决【CJ2026】
zh.summary: GenigodsLab在大型游戏盛会“ChinaJoy2026”上展出了一款以中华创世神话为题材的可玩新动作RPG《古神：恩吾》。在会场，我们体验到了充分利用水与圣宝之力的刺激动作战斗，以及与强敌“鬼天之傲慢”的boss战，所以介绍一下内容。

en.title: ``Hope of Elements - Journey of the Witch and the Dragon'' is a turn-based strategy RPG with elements of extraction. What is the role of publishers that connect Japan and China [CJ2026]
en.summary: At the ChinaJoy2026 venue, I tried out the turn-based strategy RPG "Hope of Elements - Journey of the Witch and the Dragon." In addition to the gameplay that combines elemental reactions and extraction elements, this work is supported by Harrison World, a publisher that has been deeply involved in the creation of the work since the early stages of development and works in both Japan and China. We also heard about this initiative.

zh.title: 《元素的希望-魔女与龙的旅程》是一款带有萃取元素的回合制策略角色扮演游戏。连接日本和中国的出版商扮演什么角色 [CJ2026]
zh.summary: 在ChinaJoy2026会场，我尝试了回合制策略RPG《元素的希望-魔女与龙的旅程》。除了结合了元素反应和提取元素的玩法外，本作还得到了从开发初期就深入参与作品创作的发行商 Harrison World 的支持，并在日本和中国都有作品。我们也听说了这个倡议。

en.title: Vibrant colors stir the spirit. A different type of horror in “The Color Beyond: A Zeroth Kind” that looks around at a 360-degree panorama and interferes with the thoughts of others [CJ2026]
en.summary: InfigoGames is exhibiting a playable new title for PC, "The ColourBeyond: AZerothKind", at ChinaJoy2026. This work is a cosmic horror ADV that emphasizes the story. I was able to experience the beginning of the story and the mechanism of mental interference at the venue, so I would like to introduce the contents.

zh.title: 鲜艳的色彩激发精神。 《超越色彩：第零种》中另一种恐怖，360度全景环顾四周，干扰他人思考[CJ2026]
zh.summary: InfigoGames 在 ChinaJoy2026 上展示了一款可玩的 PC 新游戏《The ColourBeyond: AZerothKind》。本作是一款强调故事性的宇宙恐怖ADV。我在会场体验到了故事的开头和精神干扰的机制，所以我想介绍一下内容。

en.title: The acquisition of EA by Saudi sovereign funds and consortia will be completed on Tuesday
en.summary: The US$55 billion acquisition of Electronic Arts by an investor consortium composed of Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund, Silver Lake Capital and Affinity Partners will be officially completed on August 4. Previously, the EU unconditionally approved the acquisition, clearing the final obstacle to the largest leveraged buyout in history. It is reported that the company's leadership and headquarters will remain unchanged. EA will continue to be led by CEO Andrew Wilson and will continue to be based in Redwood City, California. It is reported that the Saudi sovereign wealth fund will retain its current holdings and jointly inject capital with two U.S. investment institutions to support the acquisition. Officials stated that the move aims to bring long-term capital, global growth network and strategic support to EA to accelerate its expansion in the fields of games, sports and entertainment.

ja.title: サウジ政府系ファンドとコンソーシアムによるEAの買収は火曜日に完了する
ja.summary: サウジアラビアの政府系ファンド、シルバー・レイク・キャピタル、アフィニティ・パートナーズで構成される投資家コンソーシアムによる550億米ドルによるエレクトロニック・アーツの買収は、8月4日に正式に完了する予定である。以前、EUはこの買収を無条件で承認し、史上最大のレバレッジド・バイアウトへの最後の障害をクリアした。同社の経営陣と本社には変更がないと報じられている。 EAは今後もCEOのアンドリュー・ウィルソン氏が率い、引き続きカリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティに拠点を置く。サウジ政府系ファンドは現在の保有株を維持し、買収を支援するために米国の投資機関２社と共同で資本注入すると報じられている。関係者らは、この動きはEAに長期資本、世界的な成長ネットワーク、戦略的支援をもたらし、ゲーム、スポーツ、エンターテインメントの分野での拡大を加速させることを目的としていると述べた。

en.title: In response to the AI ​​wave, Microsoft announced a comprehensive optimization of Windows 11 memory usage
en.summary: Microsoft announced that in the future the company will focus on improving the running experience of 8GB devices on Windows 11. Microsoft admitted that system components make extensive use of WebView2 technology, which in turn takes up a lot of memory. The purpose of this deep downsizing and optimization is to significantly reduce system memory usage, thereby providing users with a better experience in low-memory environments. It is reported that Microsoft will first launch these measures in the preview plan to ensure that they are correct and then push them to a wider user group. It is worth mentioning that Microsoft has recommended that gamers equip themselves with 32GB of memory. However, a global memory shortage has forced manufacturers and users to continue using lower configurations, after Apple also relaunched laptops with 8GB of memory. Experts even predict that entry-level PCs may disappear by 2028. Analysts believe that after Microsoft ended support for Windows 10, some users have turned to macO

ja.title: AIの波に対応して、MicrosoftはWindows 11のメモリ使用量の包括的な最適化を発表しました
ja.summary: Microsoft は、将来的には Windows 11 での 8GB デバイスの実行エクスペリエンスの向上に注力すると発表しました。Microsoft は、システム コンポーネントが WebView2 テクノロジを広範囲に使用し、その結果、大量のメモリを消費することを認めました。この大幅なダウンサイジングと最適化の目的は、システム メモリの使用量を大幅に削減し、それによってメモリの少ない環境でのユーザー エクスペリエンスを向上させることです。報道によると、Microsoftはまずプレビュー計画でこれらの対策を開始し、それが正しいことを確認してから、より幅広いユーザーグループに広める予定だという。 Microsoftがゲーマーに32GBのメモリを装備することを推奨していることは言及する価値があります。しかし、Appleも8GBのメモリを搭載したラップトップを再発売した後、世界的なメモリ不足により、メーカーとユーザーはより低い構成を使い続けることを余儀なくされました。専門家は、エントリーレベルの PC は 2028 年までに消滅する可能性があるとさえ予測しています。アナリストは、Microsoft が Windows 10 のサポートを終了した後、一部のユーザーが macO に注目していると考えています。

en.title: At the meeting, I finally learned how Brother Chui designed "Preface to the Sinking Star"
en.summary: On July 30, 2026, Jonathan Blow, the producer of "The Witness" and "Chrono", held a closed-door meeting for the media and core players during China Joy in Shanghai with his new work "Preface to the Falling Star". The trial demo of "Preface to the Sinking Star" was launched not long ago, and it has received praise from many players. This closed-door meeting was more like a conversation that was nearly ten years late. Since the launch of the project in 2016, "Preface to the Falling Star" has gone through a long process of self-developed engines, more than half of the levels have been overturned and redone, and the puzzles have been revised more than ten times. In the independent game circle, Chui Ge has always been known for his "uncompromising": he has bluntly said that many mainstream games are "wasting players' time", and as early as 2008, he sharply criticized some popular works as "immoral"; he has never concealed his rejection of commercial factors, believing that the last thing independent developers should give up is the persistence of personal expression.

ja.title: 集会で、チュイ兄弟がどのように『沈む星への序文』をデザインしたのかをついに学びました。
ja.summary: 2026年7月30日、『The Witness』と『Chrono』のプロデューサーであるジョナサン・ブロウは、新作『Preface to the Falling Star』を携えて上海のチャイナジョイ期間中にメディアとコアプレイヤーを対象に非公開ミーティングを開催した。 『沈みゆく星への序章』の体験版は先日公開され、多くのプレイヤーから好評を博しました。この非公開の会談は、むしろ10年近く遅れての会話のようだった。 2016 年のプロジェクト開始以来、「Preface to the Falling Star」は自社開発エンジンの長いプロセスを経て、レベルの半分以上が覆されてやり直し、パズルは 10 回以上改訂されました。インディーズ ゲーム界では、Chui Ge 氏は常に「妥協を許さない」ことで知られています。彼は多くの主流ゲームが「プレイヤーの時間を無駄にしている」と率直に述べ、2008 年にはいくつかの人気作品を「不道徳」であると厳しく批判しました。彼は、商業的な要素を拒否することを決して隠しておらず、独立系開発者が最も諦めるべきなのは個人的な表現を貫くことだと信じています。

en.title: It turns out that Chinese military researchers extracted AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic and used them for domestic military system development
en.summary: Chinese military researchers are using the output of major American AI models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic to train domestic AI systems to improve China's defense capabilities, a review of Chinese academic papers and patents has revealed. Although the U.S. government imposes advanced chip export controls to China and restricts access to other strategic technologies, Chinese AI researchers are thought to have transferred the capabilities of high-performance American AI models to smaller, cheaper Chinese models using a method called ``knowledge distillation.'' read more...

zh.title: 原来，中国军事研究人员从OpenAI和Anthropic中提取了AI模型，并将其用于国内军事系统开发
zh.summary: 对中国学术论文和专利的审查显示，中国军事研究人员正在利用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 开发的美国主要人工智能模型的输出来训练国内人工智能系统，以提高中国的国防能力。尽管美国政府对中国实施先进的芯片出口管制，并限制获得其他战略技术，但中国人工智能研究人员被认为已经使用一种称为“知识蒸馏”的方法，将高性能美国人工智能模型的能力转移到更小、更便宜的中国模型。 阅读更多...

We talked about the new version of "Zero Zero" 3.0 to the preview of the upcoming major version of "Singing Tide"; from the high-quality linkage of "Cyberpunk 2077: Edgewalker" to the latest activities of "Arknights". The most surprising thing is that the MMO "Rocky" of that year released a new mobile game version. How does this "original" new game adapt to the rhythm of mobile games?

en.title: Multiplayer co-op game Broke Witcher officially announced
en.summary: The multiplayer cooperative game "Broken Witcher" created by 5TH Cell has been officially announced. In this game, players will join their wizard roommates to kill monsters, race cars, play hide-and-seek with props, or take on other crazy odd jobs, trying to collect the rent before being eaten by the giant little devil landlord. From saving towns to exploring back rooms, from racing magical crows to playing a copycat version of every wizard's favorite Snake: Slitherin' on your phone, the developers say! The world is full of unique and great jobs. Some are well paid. Some are quick and easy. Kill the monsters and save the town, but don't demolish buildings and smash entire neighborhoods in the process, or you won't get paid. Rent isn't due until the weekend, so let's kick back and relax: watch videos, jam to instruments, play tag, have some PvP in the Player Arena, and shoot off some fireworks. Sometimes, fishing is the serious business. try on

en.title: Xbox announces participation details at Gamescom in Germany, live broadcast confirmed simultaneously
en.summary: Microsoft recently announced details of Xbox’s participation in Gamescom in Germany. In addition to offline activities, the official will also conduct special live broadcasts at 22:00 on August 26 and August 27, Beijing time. The program includes exclusive interviews, special guests, live demonstrations and the release of new trailers. Xbox confirmed that the key games on display and available for trial include "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4", "Fable", "Minecraft: Dungeon 2", "Gears of War: Days of Incident", "Metro 2039", "Heaven" and "Alien: Isolation 2". In order to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the console with players, the Xbox exhibition area will bring a total of 25 unreleased new games and set up 140 trial devices for players to experience. At the same time, an interactive experience area will be set up on site, which will showcase iconic moments, classic works and technological innovations of Xbox consoles of all generations.

en.title: Shanghai Spy War Chronicles Issue 1丨Starting from the Storm
en.summary: Timeline production of this issue: Tcho_Tcho This issue of Shanghai Spy War Chronicles will follow the historical context of the awakening of the Chinese working class and the emergence of early revolutionary hidden fronts, and connect a red prequel that is rarely fully told. Shanghai is the cradle of the modern Chinese labor movement. Hundreds of thousands of industrial workers rose up to fight under the triple oppression of imperialism, feudal forces and capital: spontaneous strikes, February protests, Gu Zhenghong’s bloodshed, and the May 30th storm sweeping the country. Amid protests everywhere, workers began to spontaneously form self-defense forces. From Hong Kong seamen and Anyuan miners spontaneously organizing pickets for self-defense, to the general strikes in the provinces and Hong Kong to create formalized workers' armed forces and blockade thousands of miles of sea territory, the first generation of workers' armed forces gradually took shape in the bloody struggle. While the anti-imperialist wave continued to rise, the anti-communist undercurrent of the Kuomintang right wing continued to surge. Liao Zhongkai, the leftist leader who firmly united Russia and the Communist Party and fully supported the workers and peasants movement, was brutally assassinated, and the rift in the cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party was completely exposed. Zhou Enlai took the lead in establishing Liao Case Special

ja.summary: 今号の年表制作：Tcho_Tcho 今号の上海スパイ戦記は、中国労働者階級の覚醒と初期革命の隠れた前線の出現の歴史的文脈をたどり、ほとんど語られることのない赤い前編を繋ぎます。上海は現代中国労働運動の発祥の地である。帝国主義、封建勢力、資本による三重の抑圧、すなわち自発的ストライキ、2月の抗議行動、顧正紅の流血、そして国を襲った5月30日の嵐という三重の抑圧のもとで、何十万人もの産業労働者が立ち上がって闘った。各地で抗議活動が起きる中、労働者たちは自発的に自衛隊を結成し始めた。香港の船員と安源の鉱山労働者が自衛のために自発的にピケットを組織することから、正式な労働者軍隊を創設し数千マイルにわたる海上領土を封鎖するための地方と香港のゼネストに至るまで、第一世代の労働者武装勢力は血みどろの闘争の中で徐々に形成されていった。反帝国主義の波が高まり続ける一方で、国民党右翼の反共産主義の底流も高まり続けた。ロシアと共産党を固く団結させ、労働者と農民運動を全面的に支援した左翼指導者廖忠凱氏が惨殺され、国民党と共産党の協力関係の亀裂が完全に露呈した。周恩来が率先して「遼事件特集」を設立

en.title: AI companies hire thousands of electricians and carpenters, with OpenAI, Google, Meta and others offering the highest salaries in industry history
en.summary: As the race to develop generative AI intensifies, technology companies such as Meta and Google are rapidly hiring and training skilled workers such as electricians, carpenters, welders, and plumbers. According to the job search site Indeed, job openings for people working in related facilities have more than doubled in the past two years, and the AI ​​boom is creating jobs that are different from traditional software engineers. read more...

en.title: He steals a golden apple from a witch that can grant any wish, and fights to resurrect his dead sister. Touhou-style vertical scroll barrage STG “SANASANA” to be released at the end of October 2026
en.summary: STUDIOCHARON has announced that it will release a new product for PC, ``SANASANA'', at the end of October 2026. This work is a Touhou-style vertical scrolling bullet hell shooting game. The main character, Sana, embarks on a journey to steal golden apples from three witches in order to revive her deceased sister.

zh.title: 他从女巫那里偷了一个可以实现任何愿望的金苹果，并为复活死去的妹妹而奋斗。东方风格垂直卷轴弹幕STG《SANASANA》将于2026年10月下旬发售
zh.summary: STUDIOCHARON宣布将于2026年10月下旬推出PC版新产品《SANASANA》。本作是一款东方风格的垂直卷轴弹幕射击游戏。主角萨娜为了复活死去的妹妹，踏上了从三个女巫那里偷金苹果的旅程。

en.title: Tag Team: SNK Arcade Legends, a tag battle board game featuring SNK characters, will be released overseas in the second quarter of 2027. Terry and 6 others will participate.
en.summary: ScorpionMasque announced on July 28, 2026 that it will release the two-player board game "TagTeam:SNKArcadeLegends" in the second quarter of 2027. Six characters are scheduled to participate, and currently only Terry Bogard's appearance has been revealed, and all other characters are silhouettes.

zh.title: 《双打：SNK Arcade Legends》是一款以 SNK 角色为主角的双打桌游，将于 2027 年第二季度在海外发行。Terry 等 6 人将参加。
zh.summary: ScorpionMasque于2026年7月28日宣布，将于2027年第二季度推出双人桌游《TagTeam:SNKArcadeLegends》。计划有六名角色参与，目前仅透露了Terry Bogard的外貌，其他角色均为剪影。

en.title: "Battlefield Fuga" now available for iOS/Android. Enjoy simulation RPGs developed for PCs and home game consoles on your smartphone.
en.summary: CyberConnect2 today (July 29, 2026) began distributing the smartphone version of ``Battlefield Fuga''. The price is 2400 yen each (tax included). This work is a simulation RPG released for PC and home game consoles in 2021. The smartphone version includes the in-game benefits of the deluxe edition and DLC volumes 1 to 3.

zh.title: 《战地风雅》现已适用于 iOS/Android。在智能手机上享受为个人电脑和家庭游戏机开发的模拟角色扮演游戏。
zh.summary: Cyber​​Connect2 今天（2026 年 7 月 29 日）开始分发智能手机版《战地风雅》。价格为各2400日元（含税）。本作是 2021 年面向 PC 和家庭游戏机发布的模拟 RPG。智能手机版包含豪华版的游戏内福利和 DLC 第 1 至第 3 卷。

en.title: Steam store page for “Genkai Sabaibu!”, a slightly harsh PvE escape shooter where girls fight for survival on a deserted island, is now available
en.summary: On July 25, 2026, ZephyrStudio, an individual game production circle, released the Steam store page for the new title ``Genkai Sabaibu!'' scheduled to be released by Wakuwaku Games. This work is a PvE escape shooter in which a girl is forced to participate in a survival game on a deserted island and cooperates with her friends armed with a gun and a few supplies.

zh.title: 《Genkai Sabaibu!》的 Steam 商店页面现已推出，这是一款稍显严酷的 PvE 逃脱射击游戏，女孩们在荒岛上为生存而战
zh.summary: 2026 年 7 月 25 日，个人游戏制作圈 ZephyrStudio 公开了 Wakuwaku Games 计划发行的新作《玄界 Sabaibu!》的 Steam 商店页面。本作是一款PvE逃生射击游戏，女孩被迫参加荒岛上的生存游戏，并与手持枪支和少量物资的朋友合作。

en.title: “Console Archives Doraemon” starts distribution on July 30th. Doraemon uses secret tools to explore space, demonic regions, and the ocean floor.
en.summary: Hamster announced today that ``Console Archives Doraemon'' will be distributed on July 30th. This title is a reprint of the action game released by Hudson in 1986 for 8-bit home game consoles, and allows you to enjoy an adventure in which Doraemon makes full use of his secret tools and searches for his friends who have been sent to space, the demonic realm, and the ocean floor.

zh.title: 《主机档案哆啦A梦》将于7月30日开始发行。哆啦A梦使用秘密工具探索太空、恶魔区域和海底。
zh.summary: Hamster 今天宣布《主机档案哆啦A梦》将于 7 月 30 日发售。本作是 Hudson 于 1986 年推出的 8 位家用游戏机动作游戏的复刻版，让您享受哆啦A梦充分利用他的秘密工具，寻找被送往太空、魔域和海底的朋友的冒险。

en.title: "Daily Life of a Conveyor-belt Sushi Restaurant" is now available on Steam. A management simulation where you make sushi, grow your restaurant, and weave the stories of your regular customers.
en.summary: RogueDuckInteractive today began distributing the conveyor belt sushi management simulation ``Daily Life of a Conveyor Belt Sushi Restaurant'' on Steam. While enjoying making sushi, choosing ingredients, and building a restaurant, you will get to know the stories of regular customers through interactions with them. A 25% off launch sale is also being held to commemorate the release.

zh.title: 《回转寿司店的日常生活》现已在 Steam 上架。一款管理模拟游戏，您可以在其中制作寿司、发展您的餐厅并编织老顾客的故事。
zh.summary: RogueDuckInteractive 今天开始在 Steam 上发行传送带寿司管理模拟游戏《传送带寿司店的日常生活》。在享受制作寿司、选择食材、建造餐厅的同时，您将通过与常客的互动了解他们的故事。为了纪念该产品的发布，还举办了 25% 的发售折扣活动。

en.title: PS5/Nintendo Switch/XBOX Series X|S version of ``The King is Watching'', a simulation that monitors citizens who slack off as soon as they are not watching, released today
en.summary: tinyBuild today (July 29, 2026) will release the PS5/NintendoSwitch/XBOXSeriesX|S version of "TheKingisWatching" developed by HypnoheadStudio. This is a simulation game in which you play as the king of a country and monitor the labor of lazy citizens. Without the king's supervision, the people would easily slack off and production would come to a halt.

zh.title: PS5/Nintendo Switch/XBOX 系列 X|S 版《国王在看》今日发售，一款监控市民不观看时偷懒的模拟游戏
zh.summary: tinyBuild 今天（2026 年 7 月 29 日）将发布由 HypnoheadStudio 开发的《TheKingisWatching》的 PS5/NintendoSwitch/XBOXSeriesX|S 版本。这是一款模拟游戏，你扮演一个国家的国王，监视懒惰公民的劳动。没有国王的监督，人民很容易懈怠，生产就会停顿。

en.title: Interactive ADV for finding dogs, “Finding Polka,” released on August 12th. New trailer released
en.summary: Parco's game label, PARCOGAMES, announced today (July 29, 2026) that the title "FindingPolka" by lidlocks will be released on August 12th. A new trailer has been released to coincide with this.

zh.title: 寻找狗的互动 ADV“寻找波尔卡”于 8 月 12 日发布。新预告片发布

en.title: Why was "Ratatan" postponed? TVT development example where 15 to 20 people created 4 hardware and 10 languages ​​[CEDEC 2026]
en.summary: ``Ratatan,'' the spiritual sequel to ``Patapon,'' will be officially released on October 15, 2026 after a release delay. In the CEDEC2026 lecture ``How Ratatan was created - A case study of how we achieved the development of 4 hardware and 10 languages ​​in small-scale development'', the two people from TVT who worked on the development openly talked about how they were able to create 4 hardware and 10 languages, and what went wrong at the last minute.

zh.title: 《拉塔坦》为何被推迟？ TVT 开发示例，其中 15 到 20 人创建了 4 种硬件和 10 种语言​​[CEDEC 2026]
zh.summary: 《Patapon》的精神续作《Ratatan》在推迟发行后将于 2026 年 10 月 15 日正式发行。在CEDEC2026讲座《Ratatan是如何被创造出来的——我们如何在小规模开发中实现4种硬件和10种语言的开发案例》中，两位参与开发的TVT人员公开谈论了他们是如何能够创建4种硬件和10种语言，以及在最后一刻出了什么问题。

en.title: In the "Billionaire Game", you can own buildings all over the world and make a lot of money by trading stocks! But the last thing you need is... Showa/Heisei Retro Board Game Encyclopedia No. 17
en.summary: The most representative board game of the Showa era by Takara (at the time) was ``Game of Life'', but the one that could be called second only to it is ``Millionaire Game'', which we will introduce in this ``Showa and Heisei Retro Board Game Encyclopedia''. This is a game with an adult atmosphere about players who own buildings all over the world and make a lot of money through stock trading.

zh.title: 在《亿万富翁游戏》中，你可以拥有世界各地的建筑物，通过交易股票赚大钱！但你最不需要的是......昭和/平成复古棋盘游戏百科全书第17号
zh.summary: Takara（当时）昭和时代最具代表性的桌游是《生命的游戏》，但仅次于它的，是《百万富翁游戏》，我们将在这本《昭和平成怀旧桌游百科全书》中介绍它。这是一款带有成人气息的游戏，讲述的是玩家在世界各地拥有建筑物并通过股票交易赚大钱的故事。

en.title: The story depicts two girls trapped in the "last day" of a closed high school. Short horror visual novel “Dissolution of the Silent Union” released today
en.summary: On July 28, 2026, UmigameStudios released the new PC software ``DissolutionoftheSilentUnion'' on Steam. This work is a short horror visual novel that depicts two girls who are trapped in the "last day" of a closed high school.

zh.title: 故事讲述了两个女孩被困在一所关闭的高中的“最后一天”。恐怖视觉短篇小说《沉默联盟的解散》今日发布

en.title: What is "senior anxiety"? Collection here Vol.2
en.summary: Timeline production of this issue: Zhuzhumi Welcome to July's "Gathering Here"! Every month, more than 10,000 updates are generated in the computer core site. The editorial team continuously browses this content in daily operations and selects some posts for sharing and discussion. These posts may be popular or ignored, but they all trigger certain pauses and associations in us. "Gathered Here" is not a selected list with a clear theme, but an attempt to observe and participate in the life shared by the crew. It is hosted by the aircraft core operation team and (planned to) update monthly. This issue covers the crew content from June 20 to July 20. The topics we got from the crew include: What is it like to be a volunteer at nuclear fusion? Anxiety caused by the World Cup public opinion. Do 20-year-olds also have age anxiety? I feel like my concentration and memory have declined, what should I do? The scariest Zhongyuan night talk may come from life. Jiyou’s critical review of "The Back Room"

en.title: Deep Sea Raft Escape: Multiplayer cooperative survival game "SHORE" officially debuts
en.summary: The latest work "SHORE" from independent game developer "Underdog" was officially announced today. Trapped in the middle of the vast sea, you and your companions ride on a fragile, physically realistic raft to survive together in a desperate situation. Facing storms, tsunamis, sharks and hunger, find your way home in this survival adventure game "SHORE" that supports 1-4 players. "SHORE" is committed to finding a unique gameplay balance between exciting survival gameplay and a relaxed sand sculpture atmosphere. Players need to work together to deal with raging tsunamis and ferocious sharks, and all kinds of outrageous and extreme weather will occur. The game encourages players to be creative in adversity, survive with limited resources, and ultimately find their way back. Previously, the funny game videos released by the developers on social media have accumulated more than 550,000 views, and received more than 2,000 suggestions from users on game features, fully demonstrating players’ understanding of the game’s features.

ja.title: Deep Sea Raft Escape: マルチプレイヤー協力サバイバル ゲーム「SHORE」が正式デビュー
ja.summary: インディーゲーム開発者「Underdog」の最新作『SHORE』が本日正式発表されました。広大な海の真ん中に閉じ込められたあなたと仲間たちは、壊れやすく物理的に現実的ないかだに乗り、絶望的な状況で一緒に生き延びます。 1 ～ 4 人のプレイヤーをサポートするこのサバイバル アドベンチャー ゲーム「SHORE」で、嵐、津波、サメ、飢えに直面しながら、家に帰る方法を見つけてください。 「SHORE」は、エキサイティングなサバイバル ゲームプレイとリラックスした砂像の雰囲気の間のユニークなゲームプレイ バランスを見つけることに取り組んでいます。プレイヤーは協力して荒れ狂う津波や凶暴なサメに対処する必要があり、あらゆる種類のとんでもない異常気象が発生します。このゲームは、プレイヤーが逆境の中でも創造力を発揮し、限られたリソースで生き残り、最終的には元に戻る方法を見つけることを奨励します。これまで、開発者がソーシャル メディアで公開した面白いゲーム動画は累計 55 万回以上再生され、ゲーム機能についてユーザーから 2,000 件以上の提案を受けており、プレイヤーがゲームの機能を十分に理解していることが十分に証明されています。

en.title: 'Unacceptable': CTO responds to Xbox service outage
en.summary: Microsoft's Xbox Chief Technology Officer Scott Van Vliet responded to the approximately 16-hour Xbox service outage. On Monday, a large number of players encountered problems logging into Xbox, viewing their game library, and running games. After emergency repairs by the team, the service was officially restored earlier today. Scott Van Vliet admitted that this lengthy outage is completely "unacceptable" and will announce details about improving platform services in the coming weeks. It is reported that the outage originated from an abnormality in an external authorization service last night. Since the operation of Xbox is extremely dependent on this external service, the exception directly caused some login scenarios to fail. Permission verification processes such as loading the complete game library and launching purchased games also failed. Some publishers that rely on the same system have also been affected, causing players to find glitches concentrated only in specific games. X

ja.title: 「容認できない」: Xbox サービス停止に CTO が対応
ja.summary: MicrosoftのXbox最高技術責任者Scott Van Vliet氏は、約16時間にわたるXboxサービス停止について対応した。月曜日、多くのプレーヤーが Xbox へのログイン、ゲーム ライブラリの表示、ゲームの実行で問題に遭遇しました。チームによる緊急修理の後、サービスは本日初めに正式に復旧しました。 Scott Van Vliet氏は、今回の長期停止は完全に「容認できない」ことを認め、今後数週間以内にプラットフォームサービスの改善に関する詳細を発表する予定だ。報告によると、この障害は昨夜の外部認証サービスの異常が原因で発生したとのことです。 Xbox の動作はこの外部サービスに大きく依存しているため、例外が直接の原因となって一部のログイン シナリオが失敗しました。完全なゲーム ライブラリのロードや購入したゲームの起動などの権限検証プロセスも失敗しました。同じシステムに依存している一部のパブリッシャーも影響を受けており、プレイヤーは特定のゲームにのみ不具合が集中していることに気づきました。 ×

On the day of the layoffs, Bethesda focused on releasing big news about the "Fallout" series of games. As background, Microsoft Xbox previously announced 3,200 layoffs, and Bethesda was also involved. Less than two weeks later, Bethesda confirmed that remasters of Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas were in the works. In addition, Obsidian Studios is developing a new independent "Fallout" game, and "Fallout 5" has also entered the early development stage. The union believes that Bethesda's intensive release of bombshell information on the same day of major layoffs is an attempt to divert attention. The layoffs came months earlier than previously promised and without the company negotiating a severance package with the union. ja.summary: 半年前、Le Element傘下の「Silver City」は最初のベータテストを開始した。オンラインになってから 2 日後、ステーション B の予約リストでトップとなり、複数のプラットフォームで 9 以上のスコアを維持しました。コミュニティで最も人気のあるコメントは「最高のアート、通常のゲームプレイ」で、賞賛と残念の両方を含む 8 つの単語です。 2026年7月に2回目の試験「二分法試験」が始まり、21日間続く。再びこのヴィクトリア朝の探偵都市に足を踏み入れると、予想以上の変化を感じた。 1. 驚異の感覚 まず、最も緊張感のないものについて話しましょう。 「City of Silver」の芸術は、そのレベルにおいて依然として最高です。それは半年経っても変わりませんし、今も変わりません。しかし、私が本当に話したいのは、見た目が良いかどうかではなく（最初のテストでは誰もこれに疑問を抱きませんでした）、買い物をするのに良いかどうかです。最初のテストでは街は美しく見えましたが、街を歩いていると、いつも精巧な営業所のモデルルームを訪れているような気分になりました。すべてが美しいのですが、人が住んでいたような気がしません。 2回目のテストは違いました。実際、街角の新聞スタンドで新聞を買うことができます。

en.title: The Canadian province of Ontario has been sued over a system that uses AI to classify inmates, alleging that black inmates are being unfairly allocated to high-security facilities.
en.summary: Prisons in Ontario, Canada, have been using SAFER, an AI security assessment tool, since 2021 to assign risk scores to inmates based on factors such as arrest and disciplinary history. SAFER has been criticized for assigning unfairly high risk scores to black prisoners, and a class action lawsuit has also been filed. read more...

zh.summary: 自 2021 年以来，加拿大安大略省的监狱一直在使用人工智能安全评估工具 SAFER，根据逮捕和纪律历史等因素为囚犯进行风险评分。 SAFER 因给黑人囚犯分配不公平的高风险评分而受到批评，并且还提起了集体诉讼。阅读更多...

en.title: Make a Deal with the Ancient God, Strategy Card Auto Chess "Hand of God" will be launched on Steam on August 6
en.summary: Billion Studio officially announced that the strategy Roguelike battle game "Hand of God" will be launched on the Steam platform on August 6, 2026. The game combines card construction and auto-chess gameplay, and players will compete with their opponents in an ever-changing battle situation. In the world of "Hand of God", every card seals the soul of an ancient creature, and every summon draws energy from forces that should not be touched. Players will become the apostles chosen by the ancient gods, build decks, arrange their troops, and compete with their opponents. The game is based on auto-chess combat and incorporates blackjack-like gameplay. Every time you draw a card, you are playing a game with the ancient gods. If you are too conservative, you will be at a disadvantage; if you are too greedy, the overflow of energy will come back to bite you. The art style of the game combines gruesome themes with unexpected cute characters: weird ancient creatures are presented in a distinct beautiful girl style. Combining Xbox Play Anywhere and cloud gaming services, players can play cross-platform on consoles, clouds, PCs and handheld devices. ja.summary: Steam で特に好評を博した癒しのデスクトップハングアップゲーム「Fingertip Farm」が正式に Mac システムをサポートしました。 Windows か Mac に関係なく、すべての従業員が自分の「指先ファーム」を持つことができるようになり、毎日の勤務時間を温かく活気のある旅に変えることができます。 Steam ゲームのホームページ: <埋め込みコンテンツについては、コアに移動してご覧ください> Mac 版のリリースを記念して、「Fingertip Farm」が 7 月 22 日から 8 月 5 日までの期間限定で 10% 割引になります。また、このゲームは「野鳥観察ノート」との共同バンドルも開始されており、同時に購入または補充するとさらに 10% 割引をお楽しみいただけます。 1 つは指先でタップすることで作物をゆっくりと成長させることができ、もう 1 つは鳥が日常の視界に飛び込むことを可能にします。この 2 つのリラックスして癒しのデスクトップ コンパニオン ゲームが、共同してすべてのコンピューターのデスクトップに自然な興味を加えることができれば幸いです。デスクトップで癒しのファームタイム 「Fingertip Farm」の基本的なゲームプレイは放置系ゲームとしては非常に軽いです。

en.title: Why do you like Rosen? Voice recorder VOL.747

Each episode lasts about ten minutes (probably). The content may be some inappropriate thoughts, some sudden crazy remarks, or some evil person secretly recorded real daily conversations (dui ma) in the office. In short, even we ourselves don’t know who will participate in each issue and what will be recorded.

ja.title: なぜローゼンが好きなのですか？ボイスレコーダー VOL.747

en.title: Israel spends billions of dollars on influence operations to guide American public opinion, using AI messaging and influencers
en.summary: Israel has continued to carry out attacks on the Palestinian Gaza Strip for a long time, which is also having an impact on negotiations between the United States and Iran to end the hostilities. Amid rising anti-Israel sentiment among Americans, the economic paper Wall Street Journal reported that Israel is spending a large amount of money mobilizing AI and influencers to try to steer American public opinion in Israel's favor. read more...

zh.title: 以色列花费数十亿美元进行影响力行动，利用人工智能消息传递和影响力来引导美国公众舆论
zh.summary: 以色列长期持续对巴勒斯坦加沙地带进行袭击，也对美国与伊朗结束敌对行动的谈判产生影响。在美国人反以色列情绪高涨之际，经济报纸《华尔街日报》报道称，以色列正在花费大量资金动员人工智能和影响者，试图引导美国公众舆论对以色列有利。阅读更多...

en.title: Military autonomous vertical takeoff and landing aircraft ``Thunder'' announced, compatible with drone weapons

en.title: OpenAI discloses problems with long-running AI models and suspends internal access to unreleased models that bypassed the sandbox
en.summary: We reported that when OpenAI was operating an unpublished AI model that can work autonomously for long periods of time within the company, we observed behavior that attempted to circumvent the given restrictions and gain external access. The company has temporarily suspended the use of the model and resumed limited internal use with new safety measures in place to monitor all actions. read more...

zh.title: OpenAI 披露了长时间运行的 AI 模型的问题，并暂停了对绕过沙箱的未发布模型的内部访问
zh.summary: 我们报告说，当 OpenAI 运行一个未发布的人工智能模型时，该模型可以在公司内部长时间自主工作，我们观察到试图规避给定限制并获得外部访问权限的行为。该公司已暂时停止使用该模型，并恢复了有限的内部使用，并采取了新的安全措施来监控所有操作。阅读更多...

en.title: American Heart Association announces ``optimum daily coffee intake for health''
en.summary: Caffeine, found in coffee and green tea, is one of the most widely consumed psychoactive substances in the world and can also affect a variety of health conditions. The American Heart Association, an American non-profit organization that funds cardiovascular medical research and educates about healthy living, has released a statement on the ``optimum daily coffee intake for health.'' read more...

zh.title: 美国心脏协会宣布“每日最佳健康咖啡摄入量”
zh.summary: 咖啡和绿茶中含有的咖啡因是世界上消费最广泛的精神活性物质之一，也会影响多种健康状况。美国心脏协会是一家资助心血管医学研究并开展健康生活教育的美国非营利组织，该协会发布了一份关于“每日最佳健康咖啡摄入量”的声明。阅读更多...

en.title: Shortwave Roaming Project｜What songs were the world listening to in the 1990s?
en.summary: The title of today's program is called Shortwave Odyssey. In the era before the Internet, if you had a shortwave radio, you could capture the sound from the other side of the world by turning that little knob. We have done a lot of music recommendations on different themes in our previous programs, but it seems that our vision is always limited to a certain region, so I wonder if we would have a different feeling if we listened to music happening in different regions around the world in the same time dimension. So today, we will take this shortwave radio and turn the knob back to 1990. Starting from European and American music, to Chinese, Japanese and Korean regions, to Latin America and the African continent that we rarely pay attention to, listen to the story of world music throughout the year 🎵Songlist Timeline 01:12 Vision of Love - Mariah Carey (USA 1990) 05:55 U Can

en.title: Research shows people who do strength training live longer
en.summary: Strength training is known to not only help you build muscle for sports and improve your appearance, but also has great health benefits. A new study that followed a total of about 150,000 people for up to 30 years shows that people who strength train live longer. read more...

zh.title: WordPress 中的“左撇子用户更容易遇到的错误”将在 7 年后得到修复
zh.summary: 在智能手机上查看 WordPress 网站时，我们发现用左手操作屏幕的用户更有可能遇到仅通过滚动页面就突然打开评论回复字段的问题。此问题于 2019 年报告，但开发人员 Terrence Eden 提出了修复方案，并在大约七年后将其合并到 WordPress 本身中。阅读更多...

en.title: ``Bug that left-handed users are more likely to encounter'' in WordPress to be fixed after 7 years
en.summary: While viewing a WordPress site on a smartphone, it has been found that users who operate the screen with their left hand are more likely to experience an issue where the comment reply field suddenly opens just by scrolling the page. This issue was reported in 2019, but developer Terrence Eden proposed a fix and it was incorporated into WordPress itself about seven years later. read more...

zh.title: 我尝试在家里的冰箱里制作美味的冰。
zh.summary: 夏天如火如荼地进行，终于到了开始想念冰的时候了。冰块是外出休闲时随身携带的重要奢侈品，而最重要的是，冰块作为外出防暑的必备品。在家制冰时，常见的是使用制冰盘或者冰箱的制冰功能，但由于自来水有氯味，所以不如市售的冰好吃。因此，我们会尝试用家用冰箱以尽可能低的成本制作美味的冰。阅读更多...

en.title: I tried making delicious ice in my home refrigerator.
en.summary: Summer is in full swing and it's finally time to start missing ice. Ice is an important luxury item to bring with you when you go out for leisure, and above all, ice is indispensable as a preventive measure against heatstroke when you go out. When making ice at home, it is common to use an ice tray or the ice making function of a refrigerator, but it is not as delicious as commercially available ice because of the chlorine smell of tap water. Therefore, we will try to make delicious ice using a household refrigerator at the lowest possible cost. read more...

en.title: Artist talks about the "lost joy of music piracy" in an era when music streaming services have become widespread

Music media Pigeons & Planes published an article titled ``The Lost Joy of Music Piracy,'' which summarizes changes in the music community due to the rise and fall of pirated copies. read more...

en.title: Climb all the way to the top of the mountain from the starting point and set out for the world
en.summary: On July 11th in Wuzhen, the 4th Creators Conference of "Egg Boy Party" kicked off in the drizzle. Most of the people who flocked to the scene looked like they had just graduated from college or graduate school, but many of them were already mature park map creators with three or four years of experience. In recent years, they have been synonymous with the vitality of Eggman Park. Among the award-winning works displayed on site, some of the maps’ exquisite gameplay and mechanism design, interlocking plot layout, and dream-like scene presentation are no less than small independent games. Even though I see something new at the convention every year, I'm once again amazed at how quickly Eggman Land is growing. Many people are surprised by the type of scenes that Eggman Park can currently achieve. "Eggman Party" has held this annual gathering exclusively for creators for four consecutive years. Recognizing and sharing outstanding achievements of creators is naturally the most important thing. At the same time, the game's main creative team will also choose to announce at this time

en.title: Weird story: Go watch a game live
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. This illustration is purely fictitious. If there is any similarity... (Picture/Ronaldo Ronaldinho) Counting the third and fourth place finals, there are only four games left in this year's US-Canada-Mexico World Cup. The start time of this World Cup is not very friendly to Chinese fans, either in the early morning or in the morning. There are not many shows that I can watch calmly. Like tonight's semi-final between France and Spain, I have no choice but to give up. I don't want to get up and write a manuscript with a tired mind. My earliest football memory probably starts from the 2006 World Cup in Germany. I didn't know much about football at the time, so I just joined in the fun with my family. I even remember some boring games that made me sleepy, and I almost fell asleep while leaning on the sofa. But this does not prevent me from starting to play "Pro Evolution Soccer" on PS2. When other students are playing the anime character brawl in "Arena D.O.N", I like to operate Adriano's mindless long shot.

ja.title: 奇妙な話: 試合を生で見に行く
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。このイラストは全くの架空のものです。似ているところがあるとしたら…（写真／ロナウド・ロナウジーニョ） ３位と４位決定戦を数えれば、今年のアメリカ・カナダ・メキシコワールドカップも残り４試合となった。今回のワールドカップの開始時間は早朝でも午前中でも、中国のファンにとってはあまり親切ではない。落ち着いて見られる番組はなかなかない。今夜の準決勝のフランス対スペインのように、諦めるしかない。疲れた頭で起きて原稿を書きたくない。私の最も古いサッカーの記憶は、おそらく 2006 年のドイツワールドカップから始まります。当時私はサッカーについてあまり知らなかったので、ただ家族と一緒に楽しみに参加しただけでした。眠くなるような退屈なゲームをいくつか覚えていて、ソファにもたれながら眠ってしまいそうになったことさえあります。しかし、これは私が PS2 で「Pro Evolution Soccer」をプレイし始めることを妨げるものではありません。他の生徒たちが「アリーナ D.O.N」でアニメキャラクターの乱闘をしているとき、私はアドリアーノの無謀なロングショットを操作するのが好きです。

en.title: "Assassin's Creed: Black Flag: Memory Reset" sales exceeded 3 million copies, and player reviews rose to "mostly positive"
en.summary: Ubisoft recently announced that sales of "Assassin's Creed: Black Flag: Memory Reset" exceeded three million copies. Since the previous apology from the development team, player reviews of the game have also continued to increase. As of press time, the game's global reviews are "mostly positive" (78% positive), and domestic reviews are "mixed" (52% positive). The development team expressed special thanks to all players for their support and are happy to see the wonderful Caribbean adventure stories shared by players. The game will also continue to launch patches to fix previous problems, and the "New Game+" function will also be launched in the future.

en.title: Pearl Abyss launches cross-platform archive function of "Red Desert", sharing progress across platforms
en.summary: Pearl Abyss announced today that its open-world action-adventure game Red Desert now supports cross-platform archiving. With the latest update, players can use shared saves to seamlessly continue their adventures across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and the Epic Game Store. Cross-platform archiving allows players to link accounts on various platforms and continue game progress anytime and anywhere. Character growth and plot status can be seamlessly synchronized between different devices. Players can enable this feature through the in-game Save menu. After selecting "Cross-platform archive settings", use the link or QR code to enter the exclusive cross-platform archive page. Following the on-screen instructions, players can log in and link their PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam or Epic Games accounts.

en.title: Weird story: Sony’s cancellation of physical discs is frustrating, but it will come sooner or later
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Maybe I really think so (Photo / Ronaldinho) A few years ago, I went to visit a friend in Beijing. As a native of Beijing and a gamer, he had an entire study room and a large row of bookcases neatly arranged with his massive game collection, from domestic classics from the DOS era to the latest PS game collections. It was really dazzling. In the midst of envy and jealousy, I couldn't help but ache quietly, hoping that everything would be fine for him, who was full of pitfalls. My friends also laughed at me fiercely. After being in the industry for so long, I don’t have as many valuable collections as he does. I thought about it and found that there are actually some collections, such as the "Sword of Immortality" game signed by Yao Zhuangxian. It was really a gift from me when I went to Beijing Softstar for an interview. It is guaranteed to be a fake and is definitely not a signed version of unknown origin. But I really didn’t intend to collect more. I had a feeling very early on that I wanted to rely on my own meager efforts as an ordinary person.

ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。たぶん本当にそう思っている（写真／ロナウジーニョ） 数年前、私は北京にいる友人を訪ねた。北京出身でゲーマーでもある彼は、書斎全体と本棚の大きな列に、DOS 時代の国内の名作から最新の PS ゲーム コレクションに至るまで、膨大なゲーム コレクションを整然と並べていました。本当にまぶしかったです。羨望と嫉妬の真っ只中、落とし穴だらけの彼にすべてがうまくいくようにと静かに胸を痛めずにはいられませんでした。友達も私を激しく笑いました。この業界に長く携わっていますが、私は彼ほど貴重なコレクションを持っていません。考えてみると、Yao Zhuangxian氏のサイン入りゲーム「Sword of Immortality」など、実際にいくつかのコレクションがあることがわかりました。それは本当に、北京ソフトスターに面接に行ったときに私からプレゼントされたものです。これは偽物であることが保証されており、出所不明の署名付きバージョンではありません。でも本当はこれ以上集めるつもりはなかったのです。私はごく初期の頃から、一般人としての自分の微力な努力に頼りたいと感じていました。

After sleeping for 60 million years, they woke up and vowed to take back their ancient territory. Each CG chapter will introduce one of the four playable factions in Dawn of War 4. This latest trailer focuses on the Necron, the undead legions of the Saleh dynasty who are preparing to retake Kronos from the "inferior species" now trapped in the endless war on the surface. en.summary: The racing simulation "MXGP 26" created by Artefacts Studio has been officially announced and will be released in October. For the first time in the series, this game is developed using Unreal Engine 5 and introduces a real-time terrain deformation system. It is reported that the track surface will produce ruts in real time based on the trajectory of the wheels. This dynamic change will directly affect the physical feedback of the vehicle, and players need to constantly adjust the driving route as the track changes. The developers confirmed that players can play as their favorite riders and compete on all 20 tracks in this game. Players can hone their skills at the comprehensive training ground or refresh their lap times in the time trial. Not only does the quick match support 20 people competing in the same field, but the tournament mode allows players to experience a full season and compete for the championship. The game also comes with an online multiplayer mode that supports global rankings. <For embedded content, please go to the machine core to view it>

en.title: [Lottery] Any word can be a curse! The voice magic adventure "Meow Meow" is now officially on sale
en.summary: The voice magic adventure "Meow Meow" is now officially on sale. Can you shoot fireballs by shouting "banana"? Can teammates become bigger just by calling "Big Mac"? Your vocabulary is your arsenal in this voice-enabled magic adventure game that supports up to 4 players online. This work created by an independent team is now officially available on Steam. Players only need to open the spell scroll to bind any word into a spell command, from the serious "Fire Blast" to the outrageous "Barbecue", from "Banana" to "Avada Kedavra". You can say whatever you want and let it go. If you shout right, the spell will take effect immediately; if you shout wrong, your teammates may fall off the cliff, and the scene is bound to be lively. The game contains five floating island worlds with different themes, from Egyptian ruins to ghost castles. The map will be regenerated every time you start, ensuring that every round of exploration is full of freshness. You and your teammates need to jump between platforms to find lost instruments, while avoiding traps and fighting monsters.

en.title: Compact discs changed games, but promoter Sony wants to kill them
en.summary: Production of this timeline: Piggy Missoni announced the cancellation of PlayStation physical discs in January 2028, which immediately triggered protests from retailers and resentment from players. Ironically, Sony happened to be the most important promoter of CD technology and disc games at that time. In this episode, we start with the birth of CD-ROM and review how it allowed games to expand from a few megabytes to tens of gigabytes, gave birth to 3D masterpieces, cinematic narratives, dubbing and CG, and also changed the distribution, retail and development models. If optical discs disappear from the stage of history, where will digital distribution take the game industry? This is not only the story of one disc, but also the development history of the game industry over the past thirty years. <SPEC丨Mobile Warfare> <SPEC|TV Research>
