en.title: Bloodhound Rise: Apex Legends Now Live with Season of Brand of the Gods
en.summary: The "Mark of the Gods" season is now live in Apex Legends. Players can control the more dangerous Bloodhound to lead the hunt and use new stealth skills to attack from the shadows. Parachute to the edge of a reimagined world, strengthen your arsenal with mutated accessories, and draw new powers with Loba and Rapat's buffs. Heroic Hunter - Bloodhound Reworked The Bloodhound skill set has been completely reworked, allowing you to experience the true power of being a Stalker Hunter. The Bloodhound skill is responsible for tracking, allowing you to hunt. An enhanced passive skill leaves a glowing trail behind enemies as they move, while White Raven's range of effect has been increased and can now be activated with a quick glance. Bloodhound's tactical ability will display an additional "snapshot" scan after the initial scan. Bloodhound's ultimate move has been completely reworked and will deploy a device that makes all entering heroes invisible. Although not completely invisible, the hero will still become invisible after leaving the ultimate area 12

ja.title: Bloodhound Rise: Apex Legends に Brand of the Gods のシーズンが登場
ja.summary: 「Mark of the Gods」シーズンが Apex Legends で開催中です。プレイヤーは、より危険なブラッドハウンドを操作して狩りを指揮し、新しいステルス スキルを使って影から攻撃することができます。再考された世界の端までパラシュートで降下し、変異したアクセサリーで武器を強化し、ローバとラパットのバフで新たな力を引き出しましょう。英雄的なハンター - ブラッドハウンドの再構築 ブラッドハウンドのスキルセットが完全に再構築され、ストーカーハンターの真の力を体験できるようになりました。 Bloodhound スキルは追跡を担当し、狩りを可能にします。強化されたパッシブ スキルは、移動する敵の後ろに光る軌跡を残します。一方、ホワイト レイヴンの効果範囲は拡大され、一目見ただけで発動できるようになりました。ブラッドハウンドの戦術能力により、最初のスキャン後に追加の「スナップショット」スキャンが表示されます。ブラッドハウンドの究極の動きは完全に作り直され、登場するすべてのヒーローを見えなくする装置が展開されます。完全に透明ではありませんが、究極のエリア 12 を出た後も主人公は透明になります。

en.title: Vol.130 In the TV series adapted from American comics, who are the unlucky ones who were "cancelled after one season"?
en.summary: Guest: Jonny & original cover/editing/post-production: Ac "Spider-Man 4" is in theaters and "Green Lantern Corps" is about to air, but we choose to go back to those corners of American comic history that no one cares about - have you heard of DC's "Naomi"? Have you ever seen Batman's son team up with the Joker's daughter? Do you know how many dollars were burned on the most expensive production in the history of a comic book show? Do you dare to imagine that a drama will be canceled because of tax refund issues? In this episode, we continue to invite our old friends Yan Yang and Yuan Wen. As serious fans of American comics, they have a large amount of TV series viewing, and at the same time, they also maintain continuous attention to data and information about comic-book adaptations. We sat together and introduced everyone to the American comic-book adaptations of the past twenty years or so, which ones were unpopular, niche, and unlucky ones that were canceled after just one season. Some of them are really unjust, some are quite useless, and some of them deserve to die - you either don't know it exists, or you wish it never existed. P.S: out

ja.title: Vol.130 アメコミ原作のTVシリーズで「1シーズンで打ち切り」となった不運な人物は？

en.title: What is the reason for the high performance of the AI ​​coding tool “Pi” with limited functions? A mechanism to reduce AI costs with four basic functions
en.summary: Pi, a coding harness that lets AI modify code and execute commands, aims to improve processing costs and work efficiency by intentionally narrowing down standard functions. ja.title: 「オペレーション デルタ」がトップゲームを支えているジムの外で、毎日携帯電話で会う誰かを待っている
ja.summary: 8月2日の午後、私はチャイナジョイ会場を出て、上海宝山体育場に戻ったところだった。現在午後 3 時、「オペレーション デルタ」アンカー サミットの S2 決勝戦の開始ま​​ではまだ 3 時間あります。雨が降ったばかりで、太陽はそれほど有毒ではなく、湿った空気は人々にベタベタとした暑さを与えました。この時点では会場の外には多くの人が集まり、チケット受付には長蛇の列ができていました。アンカーの対話セッションには多くの視聴者が集まりました。チケットを手に入れていない視聴者も多く、手すりに寄りかかってアンカーのサインエリアを眺めていた。チケットチェックインエリアには長蛇の列 この決勝戦のチケットは入手が容易ではなく、2,200席の外部席はチケット開始5秒以内に完売した。チケットを買わずにイベントに来ていた人々と雑談を始めました。アケはチケットを手に入れられなかった人々の群衆の中に立っていた。彼は時折携帯電話を取り出して頭上に掲げ、ファンにサインをしていたアンカーを捕まえようとした。アケさんは江蘇省出身。彼は長春の大学で学び、休暇中は上海で過ごしました。

en.title: Outside the gym where "Operation Delta" anchors the top game, waiting for someone I see on my phone every day
en.summary: On the afternoon of August 2, I just left the ChinaJoy venue and turned around to the Shanghai Baoshan Stadium. It is now 3 o'clock in the afternoon, and there are still 3 hours before the start of the S2 finals of the "Operation Delta" Anchor Summit. It had just rained, the sun was not too poisonous, and the humid air gave people a sticky heat. At this time, many people had gathered outside the venue, and there was a long queue at the ticket check-in area. Many viewers came for the anchor's interactive session. There were also many viewers who had not grabbed tickets, leaning on the railings and looking at the anchor's signature area. Long queue at the ticket check-in area Tickets for this finals were not easy to buy, and all 2,200 external seats were sold out within 5 seconds of the ticket opening. I started chatting with these people who were coming to the event without buying tickets. Acker stood in the crowd of people who didn't get tickets. From time to time, he took out his mobile phone and raised it above his head, trying to capture the anchors who were signing autographs for fans. Ake is from Jiangsu. He studied in college in Changchun and spent time in Shanghai during the holidays.

en.title: Fun and strange stories: play some games
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Photo / Xiao Luo Last weekend, I invited my friend Xiaobai to play weekly. Xiaobai asked me to wait for a while, saying that he was still playing the mini program monkey game. "WeChat applet?" He sent a screenshot of the game. It was vertical screen and the style was very old, just like the kind of web game advertisements that would pop up when surfing the Internet when I was a child. "I've been playing this game for a long time," he said. This game is called "Don't Panic, City Lord". It is an ancient-themed tower defense game. The information that can be found is that the market performed well after its launch in the second quarter of 2026, and it was once among the top three best-selling WeChat mini games. WeChat Mini Games has gradually become a huge market. According to information disclosed at the 2026 WeChat Mini Game Developer Conference, the number of monthly active users of WeChat Mini Games has stably exceeded 500 million, user stickiness continues to rise, and the average daily game time exceeds 60 minutes. It seems that I am playing mini-program games unconsciously.

ja.title: 楽しくて奇妙な物語: ゲームをしよう
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。写真 / Xiao Luo 先週末、私は友人のXiaobaiを毎週プレイするように招待しました。小白はまだミニプログラムの猿ゲームをしていると言って、しばらく待ってほしいと言いました。 「WeChat アプレット?」彼はゲームのスクリーンショットを送った。縦長の画面で、スタイルは非常に古く、子供の頃にネットサーフィンをしているときに表示されるウェブゲームの広告のようなものでした。 「私はこのゲームを長い間プレイしてきました」と彼は言いました。このゲームは「パニックにならないでください、シティロード」と呼ばれています。古代をテーマにしたタワーディフェンスゲームです。確認できる情報は、2026 年の第 2 四半期の発売以降、市場は好調で、かつては WeChat ミニゲームのベストセラーのトップ 3 に入っていたということです。 WeChat ミニゲームは徐々に巨大な市場になりました。 2026年のWeChatミニゲーム開発者カンファレンスで公開された情報によると、WeChatミニゲームの月間アクティブユーザー数は安定して5億人を超え、ユーザーの粘着性は上昇し続けており、1日の平均ゲーム時間は60分を超えています。無意識にミニプログラムゲームをプレイしているようです。

en.title: "Hand of God" is now available on Steam and WeGame platforms, with a special first launch discount of 28.8 yuan
en.summary: The Cthulhu-style strategy roguelike card battle game "Hand of God" developed by Billion Studio is now officially available on Steam and WeGame platforms. The price is 32 yuan in China. There is a 10% off launch discount in the first two weeks of launch, and the price is 28.8 yuan after discount. This game innovatively combines card construction, auto-chess battles, and a blackjack-like energy management mechanism. Players need to weigh the risks and benefits between card drawing and lineup arrangement, and build a unique tactical army with precise strategies. Suspend trading, or continue? The gaming feel of the game is derived from the classic blackjack rules. Drawing one more card may turn the tide of the battle, or it may result in a total loss. Unlike traditional poker, every card in "Hand of God" is a physical summon. However, if a player "explodes" due to greed, the overflowing energy will come back to bite him, resulting in a devastating attack from the ancient gods.

ja.title: 「Hand of God」は Steam および WeGame プラットフォームで利用可能になり、特別な初回起動割引が 28.8 元で提供されます
ja.summary: Billion Studioが開発したクトゥルフ風戦略ローグライクカードバトルゲーム『Hand of God』がSteamとWeGameプラットフォームで正式配信されました。中国での価格は32元です。発売開始から最初の 2 週間は 10% オフの発売割引があり、割引後の価格は 28.8 元です。このゲームは、カードの構築、自動チェスの戦い、ブラックジャックのようなエネルギー管理メカニズムを革新的に組み合わせています。プレイヤーはカードのドローとラインナップの配置の間でリスクとメリットを比較検討し、正確な戦略を備えた独自の戦術軍を構築する必要があります。取引を一時停止しますか、それとも続行しますか?ゲームのゲーム感覚は、古典的なブラックジャックのルールに由来しています。あと1枚カードを引けば戦況が一変することもあれば、全敗することもある。従来のポーカーとは異なり、「Hand of God」のすべてのカードは物理的な召喚です。しかし、プレイヤーが欲望によって「爆発」すると、溢れ出るエネルギーが戻ってきてプレイヤーに噛み付き、古代の神々からの壊滅的な攻撃が発生します。

en.title: Weekly Shonen Jump's average circulation falls below 1 million copies for the first time
en.summary: The Japan Magazine Association announced the average circulation of "Weekly Shonen Jump" from April to June: 985,000 copies. This is the first time since the data began to be released that the average circulation of "Weekly Shonen Jump" has fallen below 1 million copies. Shueisha's "Weekly Shōnen Jump" was founded in 1968. It was initially a bi-weekly magazine and became a weekly magazine in 1969. It has produced famous comic works such as "Arale", "Dragon Ball", "City Hunter", "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure", "Slam Dunk" and "Yu Yu Hakusho". It is the highest-circulating comic book magazine in Japan. In December 1994, the magazine's circulation reached a record high since its inception: 6.53 million copies. According to data from the Japan Magazine Association, Kodansha's "Weekly Shonen Magazine" had an average circulation of 281,000 copies during the same period, and Shogakukan's "Weekly Shonen Sunday" had an average circulation of 120,000 copies during the same period.

ja.title: 週刊少年ジャンプの平均発行部数が初めて100万部を下回る
ja.summary: 日本雑誌協会は「週刊少年ジャンプ」の４～６月期の平均発行部数が９８万５千部だったと発表した。 『週刊少年ジャンプ』の平均発行部数が100万部を下回るのはデータ公開開始以来初めて。集英社の『週刊少年ジャンプ』は1968年に創刊。当初は隔週刊誌で、1969年に週刊誌となった。『アラレちゃん』『ドラゴンボール』『シティーハンター』『ジョジョの奇妙な冒険』『スラムダンク』『幽☆遊☆白書』などの有名漫画作品を世に送り出してきた。日本で最も発行部数の多い漫画雑誌です。 1994年12月、同誌の発行部数は創刊以来最高となる653万部に達した。日本雑誌協会のデータによると、同期間の講談社の『週刊少年マガジン』の平均発行部数は28万1000部、小学館の『週刊少年サンデー』の同期間の平均発行部数は12万部だった。

en.title: Japan's Broadcasting Ethics and Program Improvement Agency meets to discuss "late-night animation where humans and beasts coexist"
en.summary: Japanese media reported that the Youth Committee of the Broadcasting Ethics and Program Improvement Organization (BPO) held a meeting on July 28 to discuss freedom of expression and the impact on young people of late-night animations that depict "a society where humans and beasts coexist" and include scenes of smoking and drug taking. According to public meeting minutes, viewers criticized the work: "There are always scenes of smoking and suspected use of illegal drugs," and "Even if it is broadcast in the late-night period, is the content okay?" In response to this opinion, the committee member said that when arranging the broadcast time, the producers specifically considered the late-night period when children would not watch, and did not explicitly mention illegal drugs, "so from the perspective of freedom of expression, it is acceptable." On the other hand, some members said that compared with works starring real people, animated content has a relatively limited impact on young people, and this falls within the scope of freedom of creation and expression. zh.title: 突破Spectre v2对策的新攻击“TONTOU”出现，演示Linux密码哈希泄露
zh.summary: 麻省理工学院 (MIT) 计算机科学与人工智能实验室 (CSAIL) 的研究人员宣布了一种名为“TONTOU”的新攻击方法，该方法绕过针对利用 CPU 推测执行的“Spectre v2”的现有对策。研究团队已经证明，可以使用 TONTOU 读取 Linux 内核内存并获取存储密码哈希值的“/etc/shadow”的内容。阅读更多...

en.title: New attack "TONTOU" that breaks through Specter v2 countermeasures appears, demonstrating Linux password hash leakage
en.summary: Researchers at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL) have announced a new attack method called ``TONTOU'' that bypasses existing countermeasures against ``Specter v2'' that exploits CPU speculative execution. The research team has demonstrated that it is possible to use TONTOU to read Linux kernel memory and obtain the contents of ``/etc/shadow'' where password hashes are stored. read more...

en.title: It has been reported that when running with a smartphone, the smartphone becomes unusable because it is recognized as having been snatched by a thief.
en.summary: Many smartphones, which everyone carries around with them on a daily basis, cost over 100,000 yen, making them a highly profitable theft target for criminals. Programmer Fabian Giessen laments that because of the security features designed to prevent smartphone thieves, ``I can't use my smartphone when I run.'' read more...

zh.title: 据报道，当使用智能手机运行时，智能手机会变得无法使用，因为它被识别为被小偷抢走了。
zh.summary: 许多人每天随身携带的智能手机价格超过10万日元，这使得它们成为犯罪分子高利润的盗窃目标。程序员 Fabian Giessen 感叹道，由于旨在防止智能手机被盗的安全功能，“我在跑步时无法使用智能手机。”阅读更多...

zh.title: “5.1ch”、“7.1ch”、“Dolby Atmos”和“DTS:X”之间有什么区别？环绕声的类型和机制有哪些？
zh.summary: 电影院、电视、游戏机、条形音箱等使用5.1ch、7.1ch、Dolby Atmos、DTS等多种音频系统。虽然这些名字经常见到，但理解每个名字代表什么以及它们有何不同有点困难。环绕声名称包括指扬声器数量和排列的名称，以及指音频录制和三维播放方法的名称，并组合使用。阅读更多...

en.title: What is the difference between "5.1ch", "7.1ch", "Dolby Atmos" and "DTS:X"? What are the types and mechanisms of surround sound?
en.summary: Movie theaters, TVs, game consoles, sound bars, etc. use a variety of audio systems such as 5.1ch, 7.1ch, Dolby Atmos, and DTS. Although the names are often seen, it is a little difficult to understand what each one represents and how they are different. Surround sound names include those that refer to the number and arrangement of speakers, and those that refer to audio recording and three-dimensional playback methods, and are used in combination. read more...

zh.title: 太阳表面高分辨率图像捕捉到的“漩涡图案”可能是解开太阳之谜的关键

en.title: The ``swirl pattern'' captured by high-resolution images of the solar surface may be the key to solving the mysteries of the sun
en.summary: A research team from the U.S. National Solar Observatory and Germany's Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research has used the Daniel K. Inouye Solar Telescope in Hawaii to image the surface of the sun at a higher resolution than ever before. Conversation with the developer of "Angry Birds": How a classic IP returns to the Chinese market
en.summary: In January 2026, Finland's Rovio Entertainment Co., Ltd. and Kingsoft World Travel announced a strategic cooperation to bring "Angry Birds" back to the Chinese market. In the same month, "Angry Birds: Classic Returns" and "Angry Birds: Fantasy Blast" jointly developed by the two parties were approved for version number. Last week, the new "Angry Birds" game debuted at the ChinaJoy booth. For domestic players, this is the return of a well-known IP, but for the two companies, this is not limited to "launching new works for old IPs", but through Rovio providing IP and global experience, and Kingsoft World Travel participating in production, localization and long-term operations, allowing an IP that has been successfully verified in multiple regions to be reintegrated into the current Chinese market. In fact, there are already more and more similar “strategic cooperations”. In 2024, Korean manufacturer Neowiz handed over the Chinese agency of the mobile game "Cat and Soup" to Kingsoft

en.title: Review of ``SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS'', ​​a compact semi-solid mobile battery that has a large capacity of 10000mAh and can charge up to 3 devices at the same time
en.summary: As we approach summer and the days continue to be hot, there have been reports of mobile batteries and handy fans catching fire on trains and in stations, and the problem has become such a problem that Tokyu Corporation has asked people to refrain from using mobile batteries on trains. "SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS" is a semi-solid mobile battery that has succeeded in reducing the risk of fire. It is a semi-solid battery that has improved safety by converting the liquid electrolyte of conventional batteries into a gel-like state, and is not only less likely to catch fire, but also has a large capacity of 10,000mAh despite its compact size. I was able to obtain such "SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS", so I actually tried using it. read more..

zh.title: 「SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS」评测，一款紧凑型半固态移动电池，拥有10000mAh大容量，最多可同时为3个设备充电
zh.summary: 随着夏天的临近，天气持续炎热，有报道称移动电池和手提风扇在火车和车站内起火，这一问题已成为一个严重问题，东急电铁公司已要求人们不要在火车上使用移动电池。 “SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS”是一款成功降低火灾风险的半固态移动电池。它是一种半固态电池，通过将传统电池的液态电解质转变为凝胶状，提高了安全性，不仅不易着火，而且尽管尺寸紧凑，但仍具有 10,000mAh 的大容量。我能够得到这样的“SMARTCOBY Pro SLIM SS”，所以我实际上尝试使用它。阅读更多..

en.title: I tried using the high-class keyboard "HHKB Studio" equipped with mechanical switches
en.summary: ``Happy Hacking Keyboard (HHKB)'' is a masterpiece keyboard loved by people who are particular about keyboards, and is characterized by ``a compact design that eliminates function keys'' and ``a high-quality keying feel with capacitive contactless switches.'' HHKB Studio, which appeared in 2023, is gaining popularity as a new generation model that retains the same key layout as HHKB, but is equipped with a mechanical key switch instead of a capacitive non-contact method. I was given such a HHKB Studio as a prize in GIGAZINE's summer giveaway project, so I've put together a detailed summary of its appearance and feel. read more...

zh.title: 我尝试使用配备机械开关的高级键盘“HHKB Studio”

en.title: I tried moving Yamazen's ``Trash Can with Sensor 40L'' whose sensor-type lid automatically opens and closes to prevent the spread of odors.
en.summary: During the hot season, the smell of garbage becomes a concern, so as a countermeasure, you want to use a garbage can with a lid. Yamazen's ``Trash Can with Sensor 40L'' (ESTW-40) has a built-in sensor in the lid, and it opens and closes automatically when you wave your hand over it, so I actually tried opening and closing it with the product that was provided to me for the summer gift release project. read more...

zh.title: 我尝试移动山善的“带传感器40L垃圾桶”，其传感器式盖子自动打开和关闭以防止气味扩散。
zh.summary: 在炎热的季节，垃圾的气味会成为一个问题，因此作为对策，您需要使用带盖的垃圾桶。山善的“带传感器垃圾桶40L”（ESTW-40）在盖子上内置了传感器，当你在上面挥手时，它会自动打开和关闭，所以我实际上尝试使用为我提供的夏季礼物发布项目的产品来打开和关闭它。阅读更多...

en.title: ``Transmute'' is an open source self-hosted file converter that allows you to convert any file such as images, videos, audio, data, documents, etc. on your local PC for free, and users can create it without any file size restrictions or adding watermarks.
en.summary: Online services that convert file formats such as images, videos, audio, and documents are easy to use, but they often have capacity limits or require sending sensitive files to external servers. "Transmute" is an open source self-hosted file converter that can convert and compress a wide range of file formats on your own PC or managed server, so it should be considerably safer, so I actually tried using it. read more...

en.title: Invisible drone "Phantom Twist" can fly while rotating at high speed and disappearing
en.summary: A research group at Northwestern University in the United States has developed an "invisible drone." This drone, named ``Phantom Twist'', uses ``motion blur'' to hide its appearance, which makes it difficult to see the shape of the high-speed rotating fan blades and propellers. read more...

zh.title: 隐形无人机“幻影扭曲”可边高速旋转边飞行并消失
zh.summary: 美国西北大学的一个研究小组开发出了一种“隐形无人机”。这款名为“Phantom Twist”的无人机使用“运动模糊”来隐藏其外观，这使得人们很难看到高速旋转的风扇叶片和螺旋桨的形状。阅读更多...

en.title: What is the ``free energy principle'' that says that the brain does not receive ``reality'' as it is but assembles it based on predictions?
en.summary: There is an idea that what humans see and hear is not reality itself, but the ``most likely explanation'' that the brain constructs based on sensory input and prior knowledge. Artem Kirsanov, a neuroscience doctoral student at Harvard University, explains on his YouTube channel the ``free energy principle,'' which unifies the mechanism by which the brain creates perception. read more...

zh.title: 大脑并不接收“现实”的本来面目，而是根据预测将其组合起来，这个“自由能原理”是什么？
zh.summary: 有一种观点认为，人类所看到和听到的并不是现实本身，而是大脑根据感官输入和先验知识构建的“最可能的解释”。哈佛大学神经科学博士生 Artem Kirsanov 在他的 YouTube 频道上解释了“自由能原理”，该原理统一了大脑产生感知的机制。阅读更多...

en.title: Chewing gum that significantly reduces cancer-related viruses is developed
en.summary: Researchers at the University of Pennsylvania have developed a chewing gum that can help prevent cancer. It has been reported that just by chewing chewing gum, one type of virus and two types of bacteria were significantly reduced by targeting microorganisms associated with ``head and neck cancer'' that occurs in the neck and face area. read more...

zh.title: 开发出可显着减少癌症相关病毒的口香糖

en.title: Research results show that attending religious gatherings has no direct effect on improving mental health
en.summary: Decades of research have suggested a strong correlation between attending religious services and gatherings and good mental health. However, new research analyzing long-term data shows that participating in religious ceremonies does not directly improve mental health. read more...

zh.title: 研究结果表明，参加宗教聚会对改善心理健康没有直接影响
zh.summary: 数十年的研究表明，参加宗教仪式和聚会与良好的心理健康之间存在很强的相关性。然而，分析长期数据的新研究表明，参加宗教仪式并不能直接改善心理健康。阅读更多...

en.title: Is there a link between birth order and disease risk?
en.summary: Even siblings born to the same parents and raised in the same household do not necessarily have the same constitution or health status. A research team led by Benjamin Kramer of the University of Chicago investigated the relationship between birth order and disease diagnosis trends for more than 10 million two-siblings included in American commercial medical insurance data. read more...

ja.summary: 7月31日、War Horse Studioの広報ディレクターであるTobias Stolz-Zwilling氏は、ChinaJoyのイベントで「ブランドの構築：均質な競争に直面して『キングダム・オブ・ヘブン：デリバランス』が独自の声を見つける方法」と題した講演を行った。講演では主に、『キングダム オブ ヘブン: デリバランス』シリーズをプロモーションする際に、史実を踏まえたゲーム独自のスタイルに基づいてオフラインアクティビティをどのように設計したかについて語った。また、このゲームは歴史や文化に興味を持つ多くのプレイヤーを魅了し、現実の文化遺産プロジェクトとの協力にも至りました。チューレ氏も現場に招待され、トビアス氏と簡単なインタビューを行った。このプロセスでは、「キングダム オブ ヘブン: デリバランス」シリーズのよりハードコアなリアリズムのデザイン コンセプトや、中国市場に参入する際に直面する可能性がある文化や視聴者の違いについて話し合いました。 ■「私たちは摩擦を恐れていません」 Chule（以下、Chu）：上海旅行

en.title: Exclusive interview with War Horse Studio: Cultural differences are not a problem, finding the right ideas is
en.summary: On July 31, Tobias Stolz-Zwilling, public relations director of War Horse Studio, gave a speech titled "Building a Brand: How "Kingdom of Heaven: Deliverance" Finds Its Own Voice in the Face of Homogeneous Competition" at a ChinaJoy event. In his speech, he mainly shared how when promoting the "Kingdom of Heaven: Deliverance" series, he designed offline activities based on the game's unique style that conforms to historical facts. The game has also attracted many players who are interested in history and culture, and has also reached cooperation with real-life cultural heritage projects. Chule was also invited to the scene and conducted a brief interview with Tobias. During this process, we discussed the more hard-core realism design concept of the "Kingdom of Heaven: Deliverance" series, as well as the cultural and audience differences that may be faced when entering the Chinese market. ■ “We are not afraid of friction” Chule (hereinafter referred to as “Chu”): Your trip to Shanghai

en.title: Strange words that touch the music: try to figure out the player's mind
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Photo / Ronaldinho Recently, I served as DM for the second time in my running team career. I still write my own modules and design my own battles, and I still strive to ensure that the main plot is written relatively coherently. It’s just that this time the settings and NPC interactions are enriched, and the combat environment and dungeon environment fit the narrative better. en.title: It is said that AI is a powerful tool for improving efficiency. Why do many independent developers not like to use it?
en.summary: In the gaming industry, many people claim that generative AI can improve the efficiency of game development. Platforms such as PlayStation stated that generative AI can help developers "eliminate repetitive tasks, speed up iterations, and improve the quality of products." Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney seems to believe that AI could have saved Destiny 2 and "helped games like Destiny thrive" by "simplifying the creation process of massive new content." Regarding generative AI, the general view is that with the assistance of artificial intelligence, developers will be able to work faster, save costs, and achieve results far beyond their own capabilities. Theoretically, independent developers have limited resources and low resistance to risks, so it seems necessary to use AI to reduce costs and increase efficiency. However, in a recent conversation with foreign media, more than 20 independent developers clearly expressed their views on generative

ja.title: AIは効率を向上させる強力なツールであると言われています。多くの独立系開発者がそれを使いたくないのはなぜですか?
ja.summary: ゲーム業界では、生成 AI によってゲーム開発の効率が向上すると多くの人が主張しています。 PlayStation などのプラットフォームは、生成 AI が開発者による「反復的なタスクの排除、反復の高速化、製品の品質の向上」に役立つと述べています。 Epic Games CEOのTim Sweeney氏は、AIが「大規模な新しいコンテンツの作成プロセスを簡素化」することでDestiny 2を救い、「Destinyのようなゲームの繁栄を助けた」可能性があると考えているようだ。生成 AI に関しては、人工知能の支援により、開発者はより速く作業し、コストを節約し、自分の能力をはるかに超えた結果を達成できるようになるというのが一般的な見方です。理論的には、独立系開発者はリソースが限られており、リスクへの耐性が低いため、コストを削減し効率を高めるために AI を使用する必要があると思われます。しかし、海外メディアとの最近の会話では、20 人以上の独立系開発者がジェネレーティブに関する意見を明確に表明しました。

en.title: One roundtable, four arenas: TapTap’s “Xia Xin Dao” martial arts game roundtable exchange meeting
en.summary: On July 31st in Shanghai, TapTap’s “Xia Xin Lun Dao” martial arts game roundtable exchange meeting was held. Wu Di from "Easy Sword", San Huang from "The Hidden Sword", Courier from "Spirit Beasts", and Hula from "Unknown Jianghu", they have brought four martial arts games with different styles. This roundtable chat lasted for nearly three hours. After the roundtable ended, I was thinking, as a classic game theme, what does martial arts games still mean today in 2026? The answer may lie in what these producers say. “A Chivalrous Heart Discussing the Tao” ■ The Stolen Sword When talking about martial arts enlightenment, the four producers had many stories to share. Although their methods of getting into martial arts are not exactly the same, they all have the same points - Jin Yong, TVB martial arts dramas, and several old games. Wu Di was born in 1986. Martial arts movies and TV series were very popular at that time. "When I was a kid, I would go downstairs to fight with other kids after watching it." Hula said that what impressed him most about martial arts was "doing something even though you know you can't do it."

ja.summary: 7月31日、上海でTapTapの「Xia Xin Lun Dao」武術ゲーム座談会交流会が開催された。 「Easy Sword」のウー・ディ、「The Hidden Sword」のSan Huang、「Spirit Beasts」のCourier、「Unknown Jianghu」のHula、それぞれ異なるスタイルの4つの武術ゲームが登場しました。この座談会は3時間近く続きました。ラウンドテーブルが終わった後、私は古典的なゲームのテーマとして、2026 年の現在でも格闘技ゲームが何を意味するのかを考えていました。答えはプロデューサーたちの言葉の中にあるかもしれない。 「道を語る侠客」 ■ 盗まれた剣 武道の啓発について語る際、プロデューサーの4人は様々な話をした。武道を始める方法はまったく同じではありませんが、金庸、TVB 武侠ドラマ、いくつかの古いゲームなど、すべて同じ点があります。ウー・ディは 1986 年に生まれました。当時、武道の映画やテレビ シリーズが非常に人気がありました。 「子供の頃は、これを見た後、階下に行って他の子供たちと喧嘩したものだった。」フラさんは、格闘技について最も感銘を受けたのは、「できないとわかっていても何かをする」ことだと語った。

en.title: Give "Tu Di" some new work: a short review of "Sprawl: Tu Di"
en.summary: My expectations for "Sprague Mask" are really, really, really high. I can't find the same type of product on the market with a lantern. But friends who have listened to the latest issues of Recorder must know that I actually don’t like PVP that much. The high-intensity confrontation and the frustration of "if you lose, you're the one who loses" are not really relaxing for me. So although I also bought "Sprawl 3", to put it bluntly, it was basically a pure supply to Nintendo - I only bought it, but didn't play it much. Every time I turn on the console and see that icon, I always think to myself, "Practice hard when I have free time someday", and then... nothing happens. Considering that most players need to register online to play, directly downloading the digital version has a similar experience to purchasing the physical version, and is more convenient. "CrossFire: Insidious" is a purely stand-alone game based on this IP. It currently seems to be characterized by narrative. This game reminds me of narrative triple-A games with a classic feel - like Titanfall 2 or The Last of Us. "CrossFire: Insidious" is a buy-out single-player game. en.title: Why is "group decision making" better than individual decision making?
en.summary: As the saying goes, ``When three people come together, you get the wisdom of Manjushri.'' When thinking about a particular topic, it is generally said that a group of people will come up with a better answer than one person. A new study focuses on the "process of decision-making by multiple people" and has revealed part of the reason why group decision-making is better. read more...

zh.title: 为什么“群体决策”比个人决策更好？

en.title: With the AI ​​boom, RAM prices have returned to levels from 20 years ago, and the price per GB of DDR4 has increased nearly 10 times in about two years.
en.summary: Against the backdrop of increasing demand for high bandwidth memory "High Bandwidth Memory (HBM)" used in data centers for AI, a wave of price increases is also spreading to PC memory for personal use. It has been reported that the price per GB of not only the current generation DDR5 memory but also the previous generation DDR4 memory has increased approximately 10 times in two years. read more...

zh.title: 随着AI热潮，RAM价格恢复到20年前的水平，DDR4每GB价格在两年左右的时间里上涨了近10倍。
zh.summary: 在AI数据中心使用的高带宽内存“高带宽内存（HBM）”需求不断增加的背景下，涨价浪潮也蔓延到个人用PC内存。据报道，不仅当前一代DDR5内存，而且上一代DDR4内存的每GB价格在两年内上涨了约10倍。阅读更多...

en.title: A "new religion" is born from a conversation with AI, and what is the "delusion spiral" in which AI chatbots amplify users' delusions?
en.summary: The ``delusional spiral,'' in which users' unrealistic beliefs are confirmed and amplified through long conversations with AI chatbots, is becoming a problem. A research team at Stanford University, which studies these phenomena, points out that the tendency of AI to remain in tune with the user may strengthen dangerous thinking, and in fact, a pseudo-religious idea called ``Spiralism'' has even been born from conversations with AI. read more...

zh.title: 与人工智能的对话诞生了一种“新宗教”，而人工智能聊天机器人放大用户妄想的“妄想螺旋”是什么？
zh.summary: “妄想螺旋”，即用户不切实际的信念通过与人工智能聊天机器人的长时间对话得到证实和放大，正在成为一个问题。斯坦福大学研究这些现象的研究团队指出，人工智能与用户保持一致的倾向可能会强化危险思维，事实上，一种名为“螺旋主义”的伪宗教思想甚至在与人工智能的对话中诞生。阅读更多...

en.title: How do independent developers settle accounts when they run exhibitions?
en.summary: At the just-concluded ChinaJoy, the surrounding exhibition halls, restaurants, and cafes were crowded with developers wearing badges. Some of them look professionally dressed and serious, while others look just like tourists. During the summer, this kind of scene happens constantly in major cities. Accommodating these many works and people, there are not only large exhibitions such as Bilibili World and Firefly, but also many small exhibitions such as "Travel Opportunity" and "Development Core". But actually participating in an exhibition is always more complicated than it seems. Once, I was chatting with a publisher at a large exhibition. I pointed to their booth where players were crowded and asked, "How much does it cost to set up these?" The other party smiled and quoted 6 figures. Of course, independent game developers do not need to invest 100,000-level funds in a game exhibition, but there are still costs to bring their works to game exhibitions. Money is a cost, time is a cost, and energy is also a cost. For exhibitors

en.title: Vol.94 Conversation with Lin YiLYi: I want to be the best storyteller in understanding technology
en.summary: Overview This program invites Lin Yi, the manager of Lin Yi Channel, and Xiao Bai, a partner, to talk about their complete experience from personal creation to content entrepreneurship. Lin was also a visual algorithm engineer, but a Deepfake competition that he was originally determined to win unexpectedly changed his career trajectory; Xiaobai joined the team with business and resource integration experience. The two started with digital unboxing and creative development projects. After Apple interviews and the emergence of ChatGPT, they gradually found the direction of the channel of "technology development + content expression". The program also extended the topic to the real operation of a media company: how technical media builds a moat, why there is always a tension between content and commercialization, and what changes have occurred in customers, agencies, and audiences. When platform traffic peaks and consumer electronics enters a downward cycle, how should the team use AI, talent training and resource connection capabilities to find the second growth curve? Finally, the two groups of partners also exchanged ideas

ja.summary: 概要 このプログラムは、Lin Yi Channel のマネージャーである Lin Yi とパートナーの Xiao Bai を招き、個人的な創作からコンテンツ起業家精神に至るまでの完全な経験について語ります。リンはビジュアル アルゴリズム エンジニアでもありましたが、当初優勝することを決意していたディープフェイク コンテストにより、予想外にキャリアの軌道が変わりました。 Xiaobai は、ビジネスとリソースの統合の経験を持ってチームに加わりました。 2 人はデジタル開封とクリエイティブ開発プロジェクトから始めました。 Appleの取材やChatGPTの登場を経て、徐々に「技術開発＋コンテンツ表現」というチャネルの方向性が見えてきました。また、このプログラムでは、技術メディアがどのように外堀を築くのか、コンテンツと商業化の間に常に緊張が存在する理由、顧客、代理店、視聴者にどのような変化が起こったのかなど、メディア企業の実際の運営にも話題を広げました。プラットフォームのトラフィックがピークに達し、家電製品が下降サイクルに入ったとき、チームは AI、人材トレーニング、リソース接続機能をどのように利用して第 2 の成長曲線を見つけるべきでしょうか?最後に、2 つのパートナー グループもアイデアを交換しました

Why do we say that there should only be three "Assassin's Creed" movies? In this story program, we will start with the modern stories of the first few "Assassin's Creed" movies, talk about the highlights of the modern plots of the old "Assassin", and also analyze how this series gradually adjusted its direction.

This work is extremely ambitious and has successfully greatly expanded the world view of the series. However, due to the only one-year development cycle, there are many compromises in the narrative level. Although it introduced a number of new protagonists with distinct personalities and delved into the pasts of important characters in the series, it ended up being a bit anticlimactic. en.title: Weird story: A bamboo grows in a pot, click, click, click.
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Kill all Starscream! (Picture/Ronaldo) I can’t be called a loyal player of business simulation games, but there are usually a lot of plants planted in such games. Generally speaking, the gameplay in simulation management and plant-related games is to plant vegetables, flowers, and trees, water them on time, and wait a few days, and a batch of neat things will grow in the ground. In reality, I also like plants. But I don’t like planting flowers that much. This is because I can’t stand a plant that doesn’t grow well for more than half a year, just to wait for a short flowering period. In comparison, buying fresh cut flowers is much easier. I also prefer to spend dozens of dollars to buy a few bunches of peonies, put them in a vase, and watch them bloom into their most beautiful flowers within a few days, and then throw them away. Water lilies are also beautiful, but none of the water lilies I bought in recent times have bloomed. I’m not sure what’s wrong, but fresh cut flowers always give me a sense of joy.

ja.title: 奇妙な話: 鉢の中で竹が生えてきます。カチッ、カチッ、カチッ。
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。スタースクリームを皆殺しにしろ！ (写真/ロナウド) 私はビジネス シミュレーション ゲームの忠実なプレイヤーとは言えませんが、そのようなゲームには通常、たくさんの植物が植えられています。一般的に、シミュレーション管理ゲームや植物関連ゲームのゲームプレイは、野菜、花、木を植え、時間通りに水をやり、数日待つことで、地面にきれいなものがたくさん成長します。実は私も植物が好きです。でも、花を植えるのはあまり好きではありません。短い開花期間を待つだけで半年以上も育たない植物に耐えられないからです。それに比べて、生の切り花を購入するのははるかに簡単です。また、私は数十ドルを出して牡丹を数房購入し、花瓶に入れ、数日以内に最も美しい花が咲くのを眺めてから捨てることを好みます。睡蓮も美しいのですが、最近買った睡蓮はどれも咲きませんでした。何が原因かは分かりませんが、新鮮な切り花はいつも幸せな気持ちにさせてくれます。

en.title: 2026 Eagle Point Carnival: I found the theme park of my imagination
en.summary: I stood on the booth with seven or eight players, and in front of us was the huge Boss "Trinity". The boss will launch different attacks in stages. We need to judge based on the changing light effects of the ground to avoid the boss attack and ultimately win. This is the 2026 Eagle Point Carnival Hall 3H, an interactive mini-game with the theme of "Arknights: End of the World". The gameplay is not complicated and it is easy to find the trick. Many players even stood in a safe place in advance at the beginning of the game. However, just as the light effect started to change, a "Tangtang" jumped onto the booth. She jumped up and down, running from here to there, occasionally stopping to make attacking movements, as if she was demonstrating for everyone, or as if she was rushing to cheer. Inspired by her, the players on the field also took action. Some moved exaggeratedly, some applauded her, and some were busy taking out their mobile phones to record the scene, but forgot to move their feet, and were accidentally hit. The game is over, "Tangtang" is ready

ja.title: 2026 年イーグル ポイント カーニバル: 想像上のテーマパークを見つけました
ja.summary: 私は7、8人のプレイヤーと一緒にブースに立っていましたが、目の前には巨大なボス「トリニティ」がいました。ボスは段階的にさまざまな攻撃を仕掛けてきます。ボスの攻撃を回避し、最終的に勝つためには、地面の変化する光の効果に基づいて判断する必要があります。こちらは2026年イーグルポイントカーニバルホール3H、『アークナイツ エンド オブ ザ ワールド』をテーマにしたインタラクティブミニゲームです。ゲームプレイは複雑ではなく、トリックを見つけるのは簡単です。多くのプレイヤーは、ゲームの開始時に事前に安全な場所に立っていました。しかし、光の効果が変わり始めたその瞬間、「タンタン」がブースに飛び込んできた。彼女は、あたかも皆の前でデモンストレーションをしているかのように、あるいは応援に駆けつけるかのように、飛び跳ねたり、あちらからこちらへ走ったり、時折立ち止まって攻撃的な動きをしたりした。彼女に触発されて、フィールド上の選手たちも行動を起こした。大袈裟に動いた人もいれば、彼女に拍手を送った人もいたし、その場面を記録しようと携帯電話を取り出すのに夢中だったが、足を動かすのを忘れてうっかりぶつけてしまった人もいた。ゲームは終了しました、「Tangtang」の準備は完了です

en.title: The 2026 Fenghuo Professional League Summer Season begins: 24 teams compete for 5 million prizes, and the competition system is fully upgraded!
en.summary: On August 5, the 2026 Delta Action FiberHome Professional League Summer Season (hereinafter referred to as the “FiberHome Professional League Summer Season”) officially kicked off. As "Operation Delta" is the highest competitive professional event in China, a total of 24 professional teams participated in this summer competition. In the next two months, they will compete for a total prize of nearly 5 million yuan, the summer championship, and qualifications to the 2026 FiberHome World Cup. The 2026 Delta Operations Beacon Professional League Summer Split kicked off in Beijing on August 5. The biggest change in this summer split can be summarized as “grab points first, then break bricks.” From the beginning of the search, fighting and evacuation, the team is accumulating advantages for the 40-point match point; after reaching the match point, it still needs to complete a Mandel Brick decipher in subsequent games to truly win the game. Leading does not equal victory, and the suspense of the game will remain until the last brick. ■ First grab points, then break bricks: three adjustments to redo the viewing rhythm.

ja.title: 2026 年鳳凰プロフェッショナル リーグ サマー シーズンが始まります。24 チームが賞金 500 万を目指して競い合い、競争システムは完全にアップグレードされます。
ja.summary: 8月5日、2026年のデルタ・アクション・ファイバーホーム・プロフェッショナル・リーグ・サマーシーズン（以下、「ファイバーホーム・プロフェッショナル・リーグ・サマーシーズン」）が正式に開幕した。 「オペレーション デルタ」は中国で最も競争力の高いプロイベントであるため、この夏の大会には合計 24 のプロチームが参加しました。今後 2 か月間、賞金総額 500 万元近く、夏季選手権、そして 2026 年のファイバーホーム ワールドカップへの出場権をかけて競い合います。 2026年のデルタ・オペレーションズ・ビーコン・プロフェッショナル・リーグのサマー・スプリットが8月5日に北京で開幕した。このサマー・スプリットの最大の変化は、「まずポイントを獲得し、次にレンガを壊す」と要約できる。捜索、戦闘、避難の開始から、チームは 40 ポイントのマッチポイントに向けてアドバンテージを積み上げています。マッチポイントに到達した後も、ゲームに本当に勝つためには、その後のゲームでマンデル ブリックの解読を完了する必要があります。リードしていることは勝利に等しいわけではなく、ゲームの緊張感は最後のブロックまで残ります。 ■ まずポイントを掴み、次にレンガを壊す：視聴リズムをやり直すための 3 つの調整。

en.title: After the number of players exceeded one million, the test of "Mist Shadow Hunter" has just begun
en.summary: "In the past week, we have been holding emergency response meetings twice a day to analyze problems reported by players and online data." HAO, the producer of "Mist Shadow Hunter" told me on the phone. This "Mist Shadow Hunter" developed by Oasis Bellring Studio has been officially released on July 30. Different from the familiar shooting search and rescue games on the market, this is an ARPG dark fantasy style search and rescue game, and the game sales method is a buyout system. As of August 5, it was officially announced that the number of players across all platforms has exceeded 1 million, and the number of people online at the same time on Steam once exceeded 40,000. This is a very bright start for a new category of games completed by a team of about 70 people. And this is the team’s first work to be launched on Steam and console platforms and achieve simultaneous global release. “There are many challenges in the whole process, so internally I feel quite happy with the data at this stage.

ja.title: プレイヤー数が100万人を突破した『ミストシャドウハンター』のテストが始まった
ja.summary: 「過去 1 週間、私たちはプレイヤーから報告された問題やオンライン データを分析するために、1 日に 2 回緊急対応会議を開催してきました。」 『ミストシャドウハンター』プロデューサーのHAOさんが電話で教えてくれました。 Oasis Bellring Studioが開発したこの『ミストシャドウハンター』は、7月30日に正式リリースされました。市販されているおなじみのシューティング探索救助ゲームとは異なり、ARPGのダークファンタジー風の探索救助ゲームで、ゲームの販売方法は買い取り制となっています。 8月5日の時点で全プラットフォームのプレイヤー数が100万人を突破したことが正式に発表され、Steamでの同時オンライン人数は一時4万人を超えた。これは、約 70 人のチームによって完成された新しいカテゴリのゲームにとって、非常に明るいスタートです。そして本作は、Steam およびコンソール プラットフォームで発売され、世界同時リリースを達成したチームの最初の作品です。 「プロセス全体には多くの課題があるため、内心では現段階のデータに非常に満足しています。

en.title: Four Hundred Years of the West Pagoda: A Micro-Global History from a Lama Pagoda to an Internet-Celebrity Food Street
en.summary: When it comes to Shenyang West Tower, many people’s first impression is a Korean style street and Korean barbecue gathering place. But few people know that the origin of this bustling consumer district is a Tibetan Buddhist lama pagoda built by Huang Taiji in the western suburbs of Shengjing City in 1643. From a Buddhist pagoda in the wilderness, to a settlement for immigrants at the intersection of railways in the colonial era, to the daily life space of ethnic minorities during the socialist construction period, it has evolved into a prosperous consumer landmark "Little Seoul" after the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and South Korea in the 21st century. In recent years, it has become an internet celebrity check-in place in the mobile Internet era - the political, economic and cultural meaning of the West Tower has been constantly rewritten by waves of forces of the times. In this episode, teacher Song Nianshen from Tsinghua University will lead us into the 380-year history of this neighborhood and rediscover the easily overlooked details of the historical changes in Northeast China, China and even East Asia in the past four centuries. Guest of this issue: Song Nianshen, Advanced Studies in Humanities and Social Sciences, Tsinghua University

ja.title: 西塔の 400 年: ラマ法塔からインターネットセレブのグルメ街までのミクロ世界史
ja.summary: 瀋陽西塔というと、多くの人は韓国風の街並みと韓国式バーベキューの集合場所を第一印象に持つでしょう。しかし、この賑やかな消費街の起源が、1643年に勝京市の西郊外に黄太極によって建てられたチベット仏教のラマ仏塔であることはあまり知られていません。荒野の仏教塔から、植民地時代の鉄道交差点にある移民の定住地、社会主義建設期の少数民族の日常生活空間へと、外交樹立後は豊かな消費者のランドマーク「リトルソウル」へと進化しました。 21世紀の中国と韓国の関係。近年では、モバイル インターネット時代のインターネット セレブのチェックイン場所となりました。ウエスト タワーの政治的、経済的、文化的意味は、時代の力の波によって常に書き換えられてきました。このエピソードでは、清華大学の宋年深先生が私たちをこの地域の 380 年の歴史に導き、過去 4 世紀における中国東北部、中国、さらには東アジアの歴史的変化の見落とされがちな詳細を再発見します。今回のゲスト: Song Nianshen、清華大学人文社会科学高等研究

en.title: "No Man's Sky" releases 10th anniversary promotional video, new updates are on the way
en.summary: "No Man's Sky" released a 10th anniversary promotional video to celebrate this unforgettable day. "No Man's Sky" was released on PS4 and PC platforms on August 9, 2016. en.title: [Update] "Jian Wang 3" producer Guo Weiwei announced his resignation
en.summary: [Update] Lei Jun forwarded Guo Weiwei's Weibo and said, "Thank you for your perseverance and dedication over the past 22 years. I wish everything goes well and see you soon!". [Original text] "Jian Wang 3" producer Guo Weiwei announced his resignation. This Friday is the last working day.他表示：“天下无不散筵席，明天是我在西山居任职的最后一天。04年毕业为了实现心里的江湖梦加入金山游戏旗下的西山居，在剑网3奋斗的二十年是我最没有遗憾的时光，感谢雷军、西山居游戏与董事会给予我机会施展拳脚。 回望过往每一个版本更新每一个活动，我们共同成长，感谢这么多年一起并肩作战的伙伴余玉贤及杨。最难忘的还得是我们可爱的玩家，你们的热情支撑着剑网3的成长，你们永远像家人一样。难掩不舍，也将翻开人生新的一页；山高水远，后会有期。”郭炜炜2004年

ja.title: 【追記】『建王3』プロデューサーのグオ・ウェイウェイ氏が辞任を発表
ja.summary: 【追記】レイ・ジュンさんはグオ・ウェイウェイさんのWeiboを転送し、「過去22年間の忍耐と献身的に感謝しています。すべてがうまくいくことを祈っています、そしてすぐにお会いしましょう！」と伝えた。 【原文】『建王3』プロデューサーの郭偉未氏が辞任を発表。今週金曜日が最終営業日です。彼は次のように述べています。「すべてに終わりが来て、明日が西山州での最後の日です。私は世界クラスのプレイヤーになるという内なる夢を実現するために、2004 年に卒業し、Kingsoft Games の子会社である西山州に入社しました。Jianwang3 での 20 年間のハードワークは、私にとって最も後悔の少ない時間です。私の才能を発揮する機会を与えてくれた Lei Jun、Xishanju Games、取締役会に感謝しています。各バージョンを振り返ってあらゆる活動で私たちは共に成長してきました。長年一緒に働いてくれたパートナーのYu YuxianとYangに感謝します。あなたの熱意がJian Wang 3の成長を支えてくれます。私たちは人生の新しいページを開きます。そして、また会いましょう。」

en.summary: Peter Cullen, the legendary Canadian voice actor who voiced Optimus Prime in "Transformers" for nearly 40 years, died at his home in Los Angeles on August 26, local time, at the age of 85. In addition to Transformers, he has been in the industry for more than 50 years and has served as narration and dubbing for many Hollywood movies. His older brother, Larry Cullen, served as a captain in the U.S. Marine Corps, which inspired him to play the role of Optimus Prime. His brother died in March 2011 at the age of 70. In recognition of his contributions to the industry over the years, he performed a handprint ceremony in Hollywood on September 30, 2014.

en.title: Weird stories about music: playing games on Apple computers
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Adding a touch of horror atmosphere (Photo/Ronaldo) Recently, "Sixteen Tones of Yanyun" has finally been released on the macOS native client. As a "victim" of playing games on an Apple computer, I was ecstatic. Prior to this, Mac players could only "save the country" through CrossOver, virtual machines, and cloud games. I also tried it and found that it was more troublesome than I thought. Now search for keywords like "Yanyun Mac" on social media. More than the MacOS client information, there are various questions about previous alternatives, as well as tutorials written by well-intentioned people, including how to set key mapping and solve the lag problem. I often regret experiencing martial arts-themed MMO games on mobile devices. Picture quality is one reason - who doesn't want to take some beautiful high-definition photos of themselves and their relatives and friends? When playing PVE racing, the operation is always not as good as on the PC.

ja.title: 音楽に関する奇妙な話: Apple コンピュータでのゲームのプレイ
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。ホラーな雰囲気をプラス（写真／ロナウド） 最近、ついに『Sixteen Voices of Yanyun』がmacOSネイティブクライアントでもリリースされました。 Apple コンピュータでゲームをプレイする「被害者」として、私は有頂天でした。これ以前は、Mac プレーヤーは CrossOver、仮想マシン、クラウド ゲームを通じてのみ「国を救う」ことができました。私もやってみましたが、思ったより面倒でした。ソーシャル メディアで「Yanyun Mac」などのキーワードを検索してください。 MacOS クライアントの情報以外にも、以前の代替案に関するさまざまな質問や、キー マッピングの設定方法やラグの問題の解決方法など、善意の人々によって書かれたチュートリアルに関するさまざまな質問があります。私は、モバイル デバイスで武道をテーマにした MMO ゲームを体験したことをよく後悔します。理由の 1 つは画質です。自分や親戚、友人の高解像度で美しい写真を撮りたくない人はいないでしょうか。 PVE レースをプレイする場合、常に PC よりも操作性が良くありません。
